rites.name: Launtum
rites.text: Launtum is the concept of resonance that Nueriel's first roots condensed around during the Singing, a sounding that had no beginning and no record. It is not a being but the pattern by which early matter learned to hold its shape.

rites.name: Pelernaldar
rites.text: Pelernaldar is the concept of the first sounding of root and seed, the moment in the Singing when the world began to condense around living growth. It is understood in Nueriel as the pattern that tells a sprout which way is up and which way is deep.

rites.name: Riantanus
rites.text: A grim craft of hurling sharp shadow-barbs at foes, first practiced in the old courts of a shadowed realm. Its techniques passed between scholars and warriors who sought darker methods of war.

rites.name: Ameontinor
rites.text: A ranged strike technique taught to archers who loosen a sequence of arrows in rapid succession. It has been passed down through several generations of forest guardians.

rites.name: Amentes
rites.text: A dragon-kin calling that once existed only in a single forgotten rite and was never put into practice. It is remembered as a shape of power that no one took up.

rites.name: Meonia
rites.text: A tactic in which the archers coat their shafts with toxin before the volley. Those struck slowly weaken, and the method first appears in a late-era conflict.

rites.name: Telarnenia
rites.text: A battle discipline that sharpens evasion and accuracy for combatants fighting in open terrain. Warriors of the mounted riding class master it once they reach a certain level of experience.

rites.name: Telestanum
rites.text: A fighting craft in which a warrior battles with bare fists alone. It lets a fighter strike and defend in close quarters without holding any blade or weapon.

rites.name: Siantor
rites.text: A tidal ward-spell cast by the drowned hosts of the deep, a surge of sea-breath used as their common weapon. It is the standard arm of the sea-wardens who guard the marsh coast.

rites.name: Zephyuzess
rites.text: Zephyuzess is the concept of the wind that carries oaths between the Courts of Nueriel, a force that gives no shape of its own but bends every promise into motion. In the Arcane Realm during the Era of the Courts, it was said to be the first thing the council could not bind, and so it became the messenger for every trial.

rites.name: Taulenum
rites.text: A hall-keeper's rite that first took form in an old scroll of the Mistan Vaults. It lets a rider step down from a mount and stand afoot again.

rites.name: Velum
rites.text: A guarding discipline taught in the training halls of the old orders. It lets a fighter brace against blows and turn aside harm meant for allies.

rites.name: Lilor
rites.text: A swordsman springs straight upward and cuts skyward, striking anyone close by. The strike bites hardest at the very beginning of the leap.

rites.name: Teonum
rites.text: A learned art of slipping past a foe's deadliest blows. Practitioners anticipate lethal strikes and turn them aside, drawing on disciplined training passed down through temple schools.

rites.name: Teorelia
rites.text: Warriors of past ages are called back as bound spirits and lent to a living commander's campaign. Each returned champion carries a sealed charm that lets them fight once more beside the living.

rites.name: Ameontor
rites.text: A passive technique a warrior can learn without inheriting it from a teacher. It is taught to a pair of young fighters who train together.

rites.name: Serolanum
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a practitioner rouse dormant strength again and again in a repeating rhythm. It first appeared in a battle-training manual passed among the wandering war-scholars.

rites.name: Causernus
rites.text: A signature combat technique that lets a single gifted fighter strike with gusts of swirling air. It serves as a stronger form of an older practice of wind-guided movement.

rites.name: Vollirum
rites.text: A dark breath that flares as a sudden spark, wielded by one lone figure in a grim tale of inner trials. Its power belongs to that single user alone.

rites.name: Valeonantum
rites.text: A passive art of misdirection that weakens the armor of enemies standing in the four compass points whenever a fighter is struck or lends aid. It can be taught to a disciplined adept without a formal ritual of transfer.

rites.name: Serenteonia
rites.text: A passive discipline that lends steadfast protection to companions standing close by during battle. Those trained in it learn it without any inheritance from kin.

rites.name: Valeoronum
rites.text: A chilling exhale skill that a single bearer alone can wield, carried as the personal armament of one hooded wanderer. It draws on the cold breath of winter.

rites.name: Corelanum
rites.text: A passive discipline that hardens airborne companions standing beside its bearer. Each turn it grants them extra resilience against blows and magic.

rites.name: Sontaurus Miarum
rites.text: A hidden inner craft that a single warrior carries as a personal gift. It burns through the blood and lends that one fighter a restless, strained edge in battle.

rites.name: Lirelum
rites.text: A dark incantation that lets its caster strike from up to three spaces away. It calls forth the spirit of a colossal many-legged beast to slam its front claws down on a chosen foe.

rites.name: Amilaunia
rites.text: A learned craft in which a fighter draws steady strength from the ground underfoot. It is taught as a rite within a secluded order of warriors.

rites.name: Amoliantum
rites.text: A sacred working of light that banishes most hostile beasts from the field of conflict, leaving only a pair behind. Priests of the temples guard its secret.

rites.name: Valenanum
rites.text: A practiced technique that a fighter may invoke to land a decisive strike. Once invoked, the blow ignores every effect of the ground beneath or around the battlefield.

rites.name: Cosum Causistanum
rites.text: A bond-born talent that lets one fighter slip away from danger while standing beside a chosen companion. It belongs to a single wandering scout of the mountain road.

rites.name: Nestes
rites.text: A fiery breath technique bound to a single weapon, wielded only by one exalted warrior of a distant realm. It channels searing heat through the blade's strikes.

rites.name: Coriserium
rites.text: A learned craft held by a single wanderer who wields it as a personal gift. It belongs to one individual rather than being shared among many.

rites.name: Orinus
rites.text: A bare-handed fighting craft in which the practitioner gains extra striking strength while wrestling or punching at close quarters.

rites.name: Coraulanum
rites.text: A passive ritual technique where a practitioner's measured movements lend swiftness and strength to nearby companions whose spirits they revive. It is taught to a single gifted apprentice without any hereditary transfer.

rites.name: Lisantes
rites.text: A combat craft in which practitioners wield only flame as their weapon. It is one of three branches that split from an older discipline of spellcasting.

rites.name: Serauselum
rites.text: A bowman's technique that bends the arrow's flight around obstacles to strike a hidden target. It is taught to archers in the wilder border lands and appears as a practiced skill among field hunters.

rites.name: Soneornium
rites.text: A passive gift of sacred vigor that a single chosen steed of the high pantheon alone can bestow. It sits in the second tier of inherited arts and cannot be learned by any other bearer.

rites.name: Nesiarnia
rites.text: A sun-bright craft that lets its bearer mend a portion of the harm they inflict on foes. Practitioners treat each blow as a small gift of recovery returning to their own body.

rites.name: Tantia
rites.text: A passive craft held only by one noble warrior-princess of the order. It grants her a steadfast guard that aids her in battle.

rites.name: Sereolia
rites.text: A passive discipline known to belong to one lone champion. It is bound to that champion alone and guards them quietly during battle.

rites.name: Seraniares
rites.text: A tactic in which a fighter who has struck first strikes again immediately after the foe. It is found only among the warriors of one ancient order.

rites.name: Meosianus
rites.text: A quiet inner craft that a fighter can acquire without being taught by anyone. It is passed on through a single named wanderer who could pass it to others.

rites.name: Sereontes
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a practitioner call on a dancing, lightweight grace in battle. It appears in the records of two separate fighting traditions.

rites.name: Amollia
rites.text: A ritual craft of combat and aid drawn from bargains with dark powers. Its practitioners fight with tainted sorcery and also lend strength to their allies.

rites.name: Mianoria
rites.text: A quiet inner gift that lets its bearer shrug off the deadly strikes an opponent aims to land. Two wanderers are born with it woven into their nature.

rites.name: Oranum Visia
rites.text: A ground-shaking discipline practiced by a single chosen wielder, who alone commands its force. It is bound to one person and cannot be taught to others.

rites.name: Taullentia
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a warrior drives a blow with every last bit of stamina. It is taught as a skill among martial traditions.

rites.name: Viantaules
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a warrior command the open heavens above a battlefield. It first emerged within a sweeping tale of kingdoms and bloodlines.

rites.name: Amenaurnor
rites.text: A bond-born craft that lifts an ally's strength when a trusted companion stands nearby. It belongs to one particular wielder of the art.

rites.name: Veontilum
rites.text: A learned ability of seasoned warriors that sharpens their striking force, granting a thirty percent surge in offensive power to whoever holds it.

rites.name: Ceontollum
rites.text: A passive ward that hardens a bearer's guard at the start of each round once their strength has fallen to half or less. Several named warriors can learn it without inheriting it from a teacher.

rites.name: Malosum
rites.text: A rallying art practiced by a single wandering bard who fills nearby allies with renewed courage. It belongs to one person alone and is passed on to no one else.

rites.name: Oriarnus
rites.text: A fighting technique practiced by warriors of the temple orders, in which a strike is delivered as the wielder steps away. It belongs to a family of combat arts taught in the training halls.

rites.name: Teorium
rites.text: A personal craft that a single warrior carries, granting a particular bond of honest combat. An alternate bearer of the same craft calls it by a more resolute phrase.

rites.name: Veontus
rites.text: A learned technique by which a fighter draws in and takes up the protection of an opponent's guard. It is passed on through the same disciplined schools that teach other combat arts.

rites.name: Vanium
rites.text: A restricted fighting discipline that channels raw force through the fists of armored warriors. It is taught only to a select few within a martial order.

rites.name: Telialesor
rites.text: A fighting technique practiced by warriors who strike in quick, uneven bursts. It first appears in the chronicles of the Three Houses era.

rites.name: Sasia
rites.text: A fierce surge of ancestral flame that a wielder can call forth in battle. It is drawn from the old serpentine lineage and channeled into a single strike.

rites.name: Nanestes
rites.text: A dreaded breath-weapon wielded by a sinister entity, unleashing a great sphere of foul vapor or dark spikes that erupt from the ground to strike a foe.

rites.name: Neostollia
rites.text: A tripwire of fate that brings a contest to an immediate loss for whoever it touches. It must be prevented, or the struggle is lost at once.

rites.name: Lanirnes
rites.text: A passive craft of the fire-bearing peoples, granted only to the followers of a single flame-born order. It belongs solely to that order and cannot be learned by anyone outside it.

rites.name: Amastiallum
rites.text: A flame-working technique that only the ember-kin keepers of a hilltop shrine may practice. It burns with no added advantage against shapeshifting beast-folk.

rites.name: Riranum
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a warrior strikes twice in a single motion. It appears first in the Awakening tradition of combat arts.

rites.name: Viarnum
rites.text: A quiet passive craft that a single frost-touched wanderer carries as a natural gift. It belongs only to that one bearer and cannot be taught to others.

rites.name: Mastornus
rites.text: A trained technique that lets a warrior strike through heavy plating with greater effect. It was first recorded in early chronicles and has since been refined by masters of the blade.

rites.name: Oraurium
rites.text: A learned discipline that sharpens a wielder's aim and evasion whenever the count of rounds falls on an even number. Hunters of the lowland tribes teach it to their young at the first stage of training.

rites.name: Telauliaror
rites.text: A martial discipline in which a fighter strikes the ground so that a surge of stone rises to meet an opponent. It was first practiced in a land of ancient ruins.

rites.name: Valestia Teontornes
rites.text: A battle discipline where warriors wield blades with great strength and steady inner resolve. Practitioners grow hardier against magic and harm through trained rituals that reinforce their ward.

rites.name: Contum
rites.text: A cunning tactic used by a ruler to deceive opponents and turn a battle in their favor. It first appeared in a martial arts-style combat tale set among warring houses.

rites.name: Mialesium
rites.text: A passive craft that lets a fighter with a slight health edge over their foe harden their guard during combat. Certain wanderers can learn it without an inherited bloodline.

rites.name: Oresiarnus
rites.text: A disciplined fighting method in which the wielder strikes with a heavy blade-bearing haft, practiced by warriors of the old orders. It is taught as a formal art passed between masters and students.

rites.name: Tiror
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a practitioner call up the breath of the air to speed their movements. It first appears in a later trial of warriors who train at the temple sites.

rites.name: Castiasum
rites.text: A personal combat technique held by a single fighter, a practice that lets its wielder deliver harder, more forceful blows than an ordinary strike.

rites.name: Seornes
rites.text: A quiet, rhythmic technique that a practitioner performs to harden the guard of nearby companions. It can be taught to a student who never inherited it from a bloodline.

rites.name: Larniarium
rites.text: A innate inner gift that stirs a fierce heat within one particular warrior's lineage. It belongs solely to a single named wielder of the flame-bound craft.

rites.name: Volleornia
rites.text: A learned practice that lets a wielder slip past harmful sorcery more easily. It was first recorded in a tale of rival scholarly houses.

rites.name: Amiantium
rites.text: A sacred calling that a devoted healer can ascend into after mastering their vows. Those who reach it gain the ability to shield allies and restore their strength.

rites.name: Nostanum Saunosum
rites.text: A quiet guarding art that lets a bearer drift unseen through the ranks, surrounded by a veil that dims approaching blows. It can be learned by a cunning scout without having to be passed down from a teacher.

rites.name: Niantallia
rites.text: A sacred seal technique that lets a warrior turn aside blows from close-quarters weapons. It is taught within the temple orders as a ward against steel.

rites.name: Nises
rites.text: A dark martial discipline that only hostile warriors may follow, practiced solely by foes in the lands of conflict. It is found in two tellings of the same ancient tale.

rites.name: Sernes
rites.text: A bearing a warrior can cultivate that makes foes shrink from their presence. It is a personal talent held by a single character in a wartime saga.

rites.name: Telanor Nostilanum
rites.text: A fighting discipline drawn from an older combat tradition, practiced by warriors who channel their strength through a single striking blow.

rites.name: Amontium
rites.text: A personal craft held by one warrior that lets them strike back against foes who wronged them. Its power rests on the hand of the heavens.

rites.name: Sarnauntes
rites.text: A stronger form of a cursed glare, this dark sorcery is wielded mainly by high-ranking spellcasters, while lesser casters rarely attempt it. Outsiders may gain it only through hidden exploits or secret shortcuts.

rites.name: Seonanum
rites.text: A passive craft bestowed on warriors, granting them a hardened hide that shrugs off fire. It was first taught alongside two harvest-bound sisters' rites.

rites.name: Tesiallor
rites.text: A personal talent held by one character in a wartime tale, marking a bitter contest for standing. It drives that character to fight harder against a chosen opponent.

rites.name: Amistes
rites.text: A reserve of inner force that wakes in a caster when their life runs low, sharpening their spellcraft. It rises most strongly when the body is close to failing.

rites.name: Seroria
rites.text: A fire-working technique held by a single chosen wielder alone. Later rites reawaken it as a battle art tied to one sacred blade.

rites.name: Cilor
rites.text: A trained discipline that lets a warrior strike winged foes with greater force. It has long been a quiet gift passed among fighters who train against the sky.

rites.name: Maurnenia
rites.text: A shadowed craft of calling forth dark forces, practiced as a single signature technique by one particular wielder. It is performed as a unique action within the battle arts of its own tradition.

rites.name: Valiantanum Telareontus
rites.text: A disciplined fighting craft that a wielder learns through patient practice. It is taught as one of the formal combat arts.

rites.name: Taurnum Vistus
rites.text: A shadowy gaze-craft that only foes wield, cast by rare watcher-beasts and their elders. It drains the spirit of those it strikes.

rites.name: Rirnaullium
rites.text: A grim art that lets a wielder strike down a divine being. It is taught as a skill passed between hardened warriors of the temple orders.

rites.name: Seonanum Vernostium
rites.text: A martial discipline that debuts in a chronicle of shadows and ancient valleys. It is practiced by warriors who channel their craft into sudden, lightning-like strikes.

rites.name: Nallum
rites.text: A protective craft that turns aside incoming enchantments by redirecting their force back outward. Practitioners of ancient seal-keeping orders train it as a defensive art.

rites.name: Cirniantia
rites.text: A combat art that makes a fighter strike twice in a single exchange. It first appears in a storied chronicle of shadowed lands.

rites.name: Taullirnor
rites.text: A quiet inherited craft that only bearers of a certain sacred stone can pass down through their line. It is a passive art gained over time rather than something actively called upon.

rites.name: Serinanum
rites.text: A searing blast of heat unleashed from the throat of winged beasts, the flame is especially potent against frost-born creatures. It forms the most basic of the breath arts known to these drakes.

rites.name: Orosor
rites.text: A sanctified path of study that a devoted caster may enter after mastering the ranks of the lesser keepers. Those who take it gain the ability to wield the grave-touch and the fading curse.

rites.name: Ranum
rites.text: A personal combat technique belonging to a single warrior, letting him seize and wrestle his foes with unusual skill. It also serves as his special bond-aid in another battle tradition.

rites.name: Orarum
rites.text: A sacred sigil-craft technique that a newly trained adept can invoke to strike at foes. It is carried in an inscribed seal and draws on the bearer's first sworn vows.

rites.name: Rallentia
rites.text: A novice ritual technique that quickens the hand of one who inscribes a sacred mark. It is recorded among the basic methods taught to sigil-bearers.

rites.name: Coralus
rites.text: A sacred bond-technique that a wearer may call upon while carrying a particular blessed ring. It lets a bearer draw on a linked ally's strength in a moment of holy resolve.

rites.name: Valaustor
rites.text: A disciplined fighting technique in which a warrior drops to one knee to strike from low guard. It is taught in several training halls and has been revived in later years.

rites.name: Tausanum
rites.text: A tactical craft in which a commander's rallying presence lifts nearby allies, letting them act more effectively in the heat of battle.

rites.name: Vialarnanum
rites.text: A disciplined art taught only to guardians of a sacred watch, letting a practitioner strike a chosen foe repeatedly in one motion. Each blow lands with fourfold the force a single thrust would carry.

rites.name: Voleonor
rites.text: A martial calling reserved for a single ruler who bears a blade in battle. Its practitioners wield only swords and fight with heavy, direct force.

rites.name: Rantus Telalum
rites.text: A passive discipline that stirs nearby savage companions into fiercer strikes and quicker movement during battle. It can be taught to a wielder by a mentor without any hereditary transfer.

rites.name: Serollintia
rites.text: A dread technique wielded only by foes, it marks a fighter's art as a fated closing blow. It belongs to the enemy side alone.

rites.name: Amareonanum
rites.text: A patient gift of tending that lets one healer mend the wounded more deftly than others. It also lets that healer strengthen bonds of trust with her companions in battle.

rites.name: Teoria
rites.text: A personal trait that lets a particular fighter steel their courage while staying protected. It belongs to a single named warrior in the tales of the valley.

rites.name: Oraurnanum
rites.text: A sacred discipline blending battle-magic with healing rites, practiced by devoted adepts who serve both the altar and the field. It was first recorded in the chronicles of an ancient realm.

rites.name: Oreonesus
rites.text: A deep reserve of desperate will that a single warrior can draw upon, seen as the personal gift of a fiery and fearless champion. It belongs to one individual alone.

rites.name: Corerum
rites.text: A passive discipline that a warrior can pass on to a pupil, granting a shared guard against incoming harm. It is one of two advanced forms of a basic defensive art.

rites.name: Nestirus
rites.text: A ritual art that lets a fighter channel their own steadfastness into a surge of added striking force. Once learned, it can be called upon again in later trials of the order.

rites.name: Serarnes
rites.text: A ritual technique taught to novice sealkeepers that lets them guard against sigil-bound foes. It belongs to a sacred ward tradition practiced in the hall of heroes.

rites.name: Amisia
rites.text: A practiced art that ignites before a clash begins, sending searing force through every foe near the chosen target. The heat dealt equals the wielder's strength minus the enemy's armor or ward.

rites.name: Ameonoles
rites.text: A bonded battle technique that can be called upon while a warrior is joined to a particular ancestral champion. It hardens the wearer against harm during the bond.

rites.name: Orellanum
rites.text: A healer's discipline that lets a caregiver who mends a companion with a rod also stir the strength of every ally nearby for one round. It is a special technique passed among field medics.

rites.name: Amiares
rites.text: A learned discipline that lets a practitioner tip the balance between mending and ending a life. It is recorded among the arts of wandering healers and battle-sages.

rites.name: Marnus
rites.text: A sacred binding mark that a novice bearer may inscribe to strengthen their endurance. It belongs to the lowest tier of an ancient ritual craft practiced by temple adepts.

rites.name: Rialor
rites.text: A ward-craft that lets a novice bearer shrug off the binding marks of sacred sigils. It is passed on as a lesser ritual technique among the temple apprentices.

rites.name: Valeostum
rites.text: A disciplined fighting art taught in an elder world's training halls. Practitioners use it to strike with composed, measured force.

rites.name: Lantestia
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by warriors who wield both blades and longbows. It is the advanced calling reached by a specific bowman who alone may take this path.

rites.name: Valaranum
rites.text: A forceful, stunning strike that a fighter can unleash in battle. It is a technique used by warriors to knock an opponent off their guard.

rites.name: Oreostium
rites.text: A storm craft in which a caster borrows a sky-father's fury for a short while. The borrowed power then strikes a chosen foe with a crackling bolt from above.

rites.name: Sereosialum
rites.text: A ritual invocation that conjures shadowy, unpredictable phantoms to fight beside its caster. The phantoms dissolve back into nothing whenever the caster falls.

rites.name: Rernanum
rites.text: A combat technique first recorded in a later chronicle of warriors. It lets a fighter strike with overwhelming force to break through defenses.

rites.name: Serantisium
rites.text: A disciplined inner posture taught by temple adepts that lets a warrior endure hardship and keep their footing. It is bestowed through a consecrated sigil of the order.

rites.name: Tiastes
rites.text: A discipline of wearing thick protective shell-mail that lets its wearer endure blows meant for others. Practitioners train for years to carry the heavy harness without losing swiftness.

rites.name: Riasaurnes
rites.text: A mounted battle discipline of heavy physical fighting, first taught in an ancient order of riders. It is carried on horseback by warriors trained to strike with great force.

rites.name: Nires
rites.text: A ritual combat art in which a bearer channels a blazing breath into a weapon strike. It is practiced only by certain champions of a single contest of arms.

rites.name: Oriantum
rites.text: A passive ritual that strengthens the swiftness and fury of winged beasts standing beside the chanter. Those who know the rite may learn it without a teacher, though others must receive it by lineage.

rites.name: Tilenia
rites.text: A restorative vocal craft practiced by a single gifted singer, whose sustained tones knit wounds closed. It belongs to one individual who channels it personally.

rites.name: Restia
rites.text: A core craft of radiant power, one of three great classes of magic practiced across the wide realms. It shapes glowing energy into forms that bind and sustain.

rites.name: Cillia
rites.text: A cold inner discipline held by one wandering archer, allowing her to keep her composure steady in the heat of battle. It is a personal gift rather than a shared art.

rites.name: Teorniarus
rites.text: A ritual scroll carried by a ruling lord that unleashes a flurry of folded paper charms against one chosen foe. The charms strike with sharp, sudden force.

rites.name: Coreolles
rites.text: A specialized combat discipline that lets a fighter strike harder by drawing on their inner resilience. It resembles a sharper frost technique but costs less effort to channel.

rites.name: Ciantaustus
rites.text: A sip of stolen vitality that heals the bearer by the same measure of harm it inflicts on a foe. It flows through certain blades and learned techniques.

rites.name: Sostanum Valantesia
rites.text: A learned discipline that lets a practitioner resist one specific kind of hindering affliction. It first appeared in a sweeping chronicle of rival realms.

rites.name: Valistaurus
rites.text: A hidden inborn gift that a warrior unlocks after mastering a heavy armored guard calling. It is granted only to certain fighters who have trained that calling fully.

rites.name: Coraurnus
rites.text: A passive discipline that quickens and strengthens scaled, winged beasts fighting within a short reach of the one who practises it. Only certain wanderers may take it up without inheriting it from a bloodline.

rites.name: Vaustus
rites.text: A quiet inherited discipline that a single wind-wielding maiden alone can practice. It lies dormant in her and is not taught to others.

rites.name: Amarium Sollium
rites.text: A linked craft that a bearer can call on while wearing a particular sacred ring-band. It lets the wearer draw on a companion's strength through the shared ground.

rites.name: Valaules
rites.text: A hereditary hunter's instinct that lets one tracker sense prey more keenly. It belongs to a single gifted archer and also appears as a bond-born technique in a battlefield partnership.

rites.name: Oraulonus
rites.text: A practiced technique in which a fighter releases a crackling burst of sky-fire from the lungs. It is used as a weapon skill in battle.

rites.name: Ciria
rites.text: A dark rite that unleashes a damaging blast across several foes at once. It can only be invoked during every second round of a contest.

rites.name: Reollorium
rites.text: A disciplined martial technique in which a fighter drives a long-hafted spear straight forward in one swift strike. Trained warriors use it to pierce an opponent's guard at close range.

rites.name: Vesalles
rites.text: A sacred skill that lets a wearer blunt the force of blows aimed from two paces away, softening such strikes by nearly a third.

rites.name: Oriarontia
rites.text: A fighting discipline that teaches warriors to channel a shadowy hex through their blades. It was first recorded in the archives of the Valentine lands.

rites.name: Amarialia
rites.text: A sacred dread-craft that a single devoted bearer can wield. It belongs only to one lone warden who draws upon it.

rites.name: Cillum
rites.text: A dormant craft that can either sharpen a bearer's strikes to deal greater harm or harden the bearer so that less harm gets through.

rites.name: Valolus
rites.text: A sacred strain of devotional force that can be gained without teaching, held by a pair of devoted companions. It flows through their bond and lifts their resolve in battle.

rites.name: Collestum
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a practitioner take on a changed form. It was first recorded in an old chronicle of shadowed realms.

rites.name: Maria
rites.text: A learned technique that adds a portion of a fighter's swiftness to the force of each strike. It is an advanced version of an older practice, and only one particular warrior has mastered it.

rites.name: Tianor
rites.text: A healer's rite that calls forth several borrowed warriors to fight beside the caster. The summoned fighters grow stronger as the caster gains skill, but they fade if the caster falls.

rites.name: Coraullus Reosor
rites.text: A disciplined fighting technique that a warrior performs by drawing back a heavy weapon with great force. It has been passed down through generations of combat training.

rites.name: Nollor
rites.text: A winged rider's advanced calling that a flying knight may grow into. Those who take it gain a flame spell and move through the sky like the sorcerer-riders of older tales.

rites.name: Mallones
rites.text: A spear-skill that can be taught to two wandering fighters who never inherited it. It exists only within a single hero-gathering tradition.

rites.name: Sestarnor
rites.text: A quiet, inborn gift that a single bearer carries, granting them a steady flow of insight others cannot draw upon. It is reserved for one particular sort of practitioner and cannot be taught or shared.

rites.name: Sorium
rites.text: A ritual craft through which a divine patron grants a favored practitioner a sacred gift of aid. It is a learned technique that debuted in the realm's latest tale of warring houses.

rites.name: Mernanium
rites.text: A fighting discipline in which the wielder strikes with storm-charged force. It is taught as a martial technique among warriors of the temple-keeping orders.

rites.name: Amirnelles
rites.text: A fiery incantation that summons a hellish spirit to the field, where two blazing spears strike every foe in the nine squares surrounding the caster. Because of its violence, it can only be unleashed on every second turn.

rites.name: Sereostor Teleosium
rites.text: A chant sung by two voices that restores a lost creature to its former self and clear mind. Singers find it easier to perform in moments of deep calm.

rites.name: Orauria
rites.text: A sacred sung craft in which singers voice ancient words to a melody, and the tune and lyrics decide what the song does. Royal lineages keep songs that grant a second action, restore spirits, or calm a dangerous force.

rites.name: Meolintum
rites.text: A combat technique that exists in the world but is rarely practiced. It first appeared in a chronicle of sworn warriors and their blades.

rites.name: Coralaunia
rites.text: A stronger form of a sky-breaking strike, it can be drawn only through a single ceremonial blade. Its wielder releases a more forceful blow than the lesser technique it grows from.

rites.name: Valenteonor
rites.text: A disciplined combat technique in which a warrior waits for an opponent's blow and then answers it with a stronger counterstrike. It is taught as a skill within the arts of a fighting order.

rites.name: Saulentia
rites.text: A fighting discipline in which a warrior lands rapid successive hits. It is practiced as a martial craft within the world's combat traditions.

rites.name: Niantes
rites.text: A dark sorcery that lets its caster peer through another's eyes. Only one fell sorcerer is known to wield this forbidden art.

rites.name: Telarnes
rites.text: A battle-honed skill that a warrior of the orders may unleash as a singular, signature deed in combat. It belongs to one particular fighter alone.

rites.name: Nillanum
rites.text: A dark sorcery that can be cast only by hostile foes, drawn from the shadowy arts of a cursed tradition. It belongs to the dark craft of the sorcerers who wield it against travelers.

rites.name: Veonium
rites.text: A recurring gift that lets a bearer endure a blow that would otherwise be lethal. Its exact workings shift from one telling to the next, but its purpose stays the same: keeping the bearer standing.

rites.name: Amialus
rites.text: A sacred seal that grants a lasting shield of invulnerability to its bearer. It can be lifted only by completing a specific ritual of cold.

rites.name: Orarnauntus
rites.text: A flaring burst of heat that a single ruler can call forth in battle. It is wielded as a special combat technique unique to one commander.

rites.name: Meoselor
rites.text: A personal gift held by a single commander, granting him vast strength whenever his ten chosen champions stand near him in battle.

rites.name: Taria
rites.text: A personal craft held by a single gifted wanderer, passed to no one else. It marks its bearer as hostile to a rival lineage.

rites.name: Verausium
rites.text: A combat discipline taught in a temple order, where a fighter strikes in a swift, moonlit arc. Later, a champion of a far-off realm adopts a variant of it as a signature technique.

rites.name: Orinolor
rites.text: A ruler's innate calling that strengthens the bearer's bond with their people. It is an inborn talent that marks the one born to lead.

rites.name: Serantanum Sariania
rites.text: A battle technique held only by one hero, a special skill that lets a warrior unleash a thunderous bellow in combat. It belongs to a single bearer alone.

rites.name: Amelliasus
rites.text: A quiet discipline taught to blade-bearers that lets them grow faster in skill, so long as they walk away from the clash alive. Only one dedicated teacher passes it on directly.

rites.name: Corelum
rites.text: A personal gift of solemn revelry that belongs to one particular person. It stirs an inner power tied to sorrow and mourning rites.

rites.name: Corarnanum
rites.text: A blue scripture tome that doubles as a battle skill for a wielder. It lets its bearer strike with the sacred power bound inside its pages.

rites.name: Vollastanum
rites.text: A rare sealed parchment that grants a seasoned fighter the mastery technique of their calling when unrolled. Only a few copies can be found, so each one must be used with care.

rites.name: Selonia
rites.text: A learned trick of playful misdirection that one particular wanderer carries as a personal knack. It is passed on to no one else in the tale.

rites.name: Masum
rites.text: A disciplined combat art in which a fighter gathers force into one devastating blow. It is taught among warrior schools as a technique of martial mastery.

rites.name: Valestum
rites.text: A ninth-ranked scroll of sacred magic, drawn from the ninth creature of a twelve-beast astrological cycle. It sits within a realm's ordered hierarchy of spells.

rites.name: Nellia
rites.text: A worn, ancient bundle of pages that a fighter can unleash in battle. It hurls a flurry of aged leaves at a chosen foe.

rites.name: Nauria Sereonus
rites.text: A fighting craft that lets a warrior strike back with raw force whenever an unseen foe lands a blow from afar. The retaliation matches the strength of the one who is struck.

rites.name: Serarus
rites.text: A dark rite that tears the ground apart from afar, splitting stone and shaking the earth beneath enemies. Mages of an older craft have long wielded it as a weapon of ruin.

rites.name: Sialontes
rites.text: A fighting discipline that channels breath-like force into a sudden rush of wind. It is practiced as a martial technique among warriors.

rites.name: Lalines
rites.text: A quiet passive gift that a single keeper of a sacred squirrel-spirit carries within their chest. It steadily restores wounds and resolve for those who stand near the bearer.

rites.name: Tinterum
rites.text: A trained fighting discipline in which a practitioner channels inner force into a strike. It is taught among the combat schools of the realm.

rites.name: Meontirum
rites.text: A grim, personal gift carried by a fearsome undead warrior, shared also by a knight of another realm. It is a power bound to a single bearer and tied to their own dark nature.

rites.name: Mastia
rites.text: A bound ward that a single caster carries to smother the spellwork of anyone standing nearby. Within a short span, every mage is left unable to cast, whether to strike foes or to aid allies.

rites.name: Oriles Nollia
rites.text: A fiery spell-tome that calls down blazing rocks from the sky. It was first recorded in a chronicle of ancient mages.

rites.name: Sornianus
rites.text: A learned discipline of sorcerers that sharpens the mind of a caster. It first appeared in a recent tale of war and three rival houses.

rites.name: Cisium Coreollus
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by warriors in the high rocky lands. It is a trained skill that a fighter can learn and call upon in battle.

rites.name: Venes Coranor
rites.text: A ritual fighting art in which a warrior moves through choreographed strikes with a blade. It is practiced only by those granted special training within a select circle.

rites.name: Rontenus
rites.text: A personal technique belonging to a single practitioner, passed through a single named student. It is a unique discipline meant only for its original wielder.

rites.name: Meonanum Rantes
rites.text: A battle discipline that a warrior learns to command the weather and turn a field into a storm. It first appeared in a sweeping campaign of martial arts.

rites.name: Telastenum
rites.text: A ritual technique that lets a warrior channel the dark heavens to strike with greatly amplified force. It also serves as the foundation for two more advanced arts.

rites.name: Vauliarnium
rites.text: A learned fighting craft that lets a warrior strike from unexpected angles. It is a combat skill that marks its user as a trained and cunning fighter.

rites.name: Amiasanum Leontolia
rites.text: A fighting technique where a warrior strikes with quick, cutting motions that are hard to see coming. It is taught in temple halls and can be carried into battle as a steady, lasting skill.

rites.name: Cistentium
rites.text: A shadowed spell that siphons vitality from a foe and feeds it back to the caster. Its alignment has shifted between light and dark across different traditions.

rites.name: Laleosanum
rites.text: A healer's craft in which a caster mending a companion with a staff grants every ally a brief surge of quickness for one turn. It belongs to the class of special techniques that reward careful timing.

rites.name: Tinum
rites.text: A temple-taught discipline that hardens the body, adding a steady measure of raw force and resistance to whoever practices it. Its benefit is the same fixed amount for every adept.

rites.name: Amianes Telaurnor
rites.text: A helper's gentle technique that mends a companion's wounds while easing them a short step away from the one who performs it.

rites.name: Nestanum
rites.text: A personal craft held by a single warrior in one tale of ancient war-songs. It is a hidden technique passed from one fighter to another.

rites.name: Rintia Sialontum
rites.text: A dark sorcery that fires a piercing beam of cursed light from the eyes of its caster. Only one lone sorcerer of the old orders is known to wield it.

rites.name: Tornenum
rites.text: A tribe-bound art that lets a fighter answer unseen blows with a return strike equal to their own might. Only certain winged kin of the old beast-folk may call upon it.

rites.name: Teleonum
rites.text: A discipline of solitude in which a practitioner gains sharper aim and quicker footing whenever no companions stand close by. Riders of winged beasts learn it once they reach a seasoned rank.

rites.name: Reosiria
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a practitioner draw vigor out of an opponent and add it to their own body. It is recognized under a different title in a later telling of the same tradition.

rites.name: Valostor
rites.text: A fighting maneuver in which a warrior unleashes a violent burst of fire upon an opponent. It is taught as a technique for combat.

rites.name: Teleosus Coraurus
rites.text: A temple-taught rite of encouragement that lends added strength to a nearby companion and to those standing close around them until the current turn ends. It can be learned by a fellow traveler without inheriting it.

rites.name: Valaulanum
rites.text: A dark-kin craft that only the shadow-winged drakes may practice. When invoked, it hardens the guards and wards of nearby companions.

rites.name: Orarnum
rites.text: A temple-taught technique that lets a fighter's heartbeat race, granting sudden speed. It is bound into sacred seals worn by warriors of the old orders.

rites.name: Corianum
rites.text: A specialized craft used by nimble rogues to open locked barriers by touch alone. It first appeared among the wandering thieves of an older tale and later spread to a wider order of warriors.

rites.name: Amasernum
rites.text: A binding craft that only foes wield, restraining the arcane abilities of a target. It appears as a dark rite practiced by hostile sorcerers.

rites.name: Lilor Vornes
rites.text: A combat-trained spellcaster discipline practiced by warriors who weave arcane force into battle. It appears only within a single distant realm and its record.

rites.name: Lialus
rites.text: A breath-borne arcane discharge that a winged caster unleashes to strike foes with enchanted force. It also shields the caster, dulling any spell aimed back at them.

rites.name: Vorium
rites.text: A quiet hidden craft that a practitioner awakens in a special manner. It belongs to the family of unusual gifts that stand apart from ordinary techniques.

rites.name: Sereontalum
rites.text: A trained technique that lets a fighter slip past incoming swords more easily. It first appeared in a cycle of conflict among rival noble houses.

rites.name: Telarnes Veonum
rites.text: A dark rite summons a sinister storm-cloud onto the field that traps a chosen foe in a cage of shadow. Wailing restless dead rise within the cage and drown the victim in their torment, leaving it unable to strike back.

rites.name: Vonum Amernanum
rites.text: A coordinated strike performed by a group of three fighters working together as one unit. It first appeared in a sacred duel record of an ancient order.

rites.name: Seriasium Liastornum
rites.text: A battle craft in which a warrior lets out a furious shout that fills the foe with dread. It is practiced by those who wield blades in the wild frontier.

rites.name: Vaunes
rites.text: A bound tome that calls a single bolt of sky-fire down onto one chosen foe. It is the simplest form of this craft, striking hard and sometimes landing a sharper blow.

rites.name: Coraria
rites.text: A combat craft in which practitioners shape gusts of air as their only weapon. It branches from a older general art of spellcasting and is taught in the storm-temples of the realm.

rites.name: Ameollia Ceontirum
rites.text: A personal martial knack held by a single warrior, a discipline that lets the wielder strike with three blades of intent at once. It is passed through one bearer and belongs to no order.

rites.name: Veleorus
rites.text: A fighting discipline in which a warrior strikes with a sudden burst of lightning-like momentum. It is taught among combat schools as a learned art of battle.

rites.name: Valonases
rites.text: A windborne craft that lets one chosen practitioner strike distant foes with small gusts that cut the air. Only one bearer is known to hold it, and it comes with them from birth.

rites.name: Leornones
rites.text: A potent lightning incantation drawn from the arcane arts. It hurls a crackling bolt of storm energy at a chosen foe.

rites.name: Reollestor
rites.text: A sacred fighting discipline that a warrior unlocks by carrying a three-pronged spear. It serves as the elevated form of a guardian's training.

rites.name: Sereonum
rites.text: A learned craft of green devotion, held personally by a single bearer. It is a gift passed to one individual, granting them a faithful bond with growing things.

rites.name: Vesilus
rites.text: A disciplined craft of channeling air currents into battle spells, practiced by a select circle of trained fighters. Those who master it bend breezes to strike foes from afar.

rites.name: Saulentum
rites.text: A combat craft for sword-wielding rogues who grow stronger than their nimble kin. They can still pilfer from foes and pick locks without keys.

rites.name: Sinteorum
rites.text: A battle discipline in which a fighter releases a stored blast of sound and force. It is a martial technique taught within the combat arts.

rites.name: Naullanum Serines
rites.text: A tremor-born craft that tears the earth open beneath foes. It first surfaces in an early chronicle of a wandering warband.

rites.name: Saulor
rites.text: A sacred melody that is heard during rites tied to a luminous divine presence. It accompanies moments when that being is near the people of the land.

rites.name: Reosernes
rites.text: A disciplined fighting craft in which a warrior trained in the blade attains flawless skill and precision with the sword. It is practiced only by those who have reached its highest rank.

rites.name: Amialenus
rites.text: A flowing attunement that grants bonuses gained through close bonds between companions. It blends defensive steadiness with striking power, shaping which benefits each partnership yields.

rites.name: Taureolor
rites.text: A lightning charm woven only by sky-keepers within a high sanctuary of guidance. Unlike other storm charms, it grants no special advantage against scaled winged beings.

rites.name: Lelus
rites.text: A bending of distance that lets a bearer step across the space between two points in an instant. It is usually channeled through a carved rod or a sacred chant.

rites.name: Senum
rites.text: A sworn-grudge craft passed down by one ritual-keeper, in which a wronged soul gains strength against the one who did the harm. It is held by a single practitioner and is known only to those who keep the old oaths.

rites.name: Niastanium
rites.text: A withered ember-breath weapon technique bound to a single wielder, passed down as a sacred gift. It draws on heated, fading breath to strike foes with scorching force.

rites.name: Ameolum
rites.text: A healer's trained craft in which a wielder who mends a companion with a staff briefly quickens and empowers the whole gathered band for one turn.

rites.name: Amaserum
rites.text: A windborne rite carried by one warrior, who calls up several gusts of blade-shaped air that rush at a chosen foe and slice clean through them.

rites.name: Rires
rites.text: A fighting discipline in which a warrior shifts between a human shape and a fierce pack-beast form, drawing the change from a stone that holds gathered force. It mirrors a rival craft practiced across the sea.

rites.name: Niaranum
rites.text: A disciplined battle technique passed among elite fighters of an old martial order. It can be learned only by a single chosen practitioner at a time.

rites.name: Caulliasor
rites.text: A personal inner discipline that one gifted bard-mage keeps as their own. It is a craft of steadfast spirit passed through a single bearer.

rites.name: Rales
rites.text: A learned discipline practiced by those who fly winged serpents into battle. It grants the practitioner a sharpened sense of tactics and insight gained while riding.

rites.name: Amaurnintum
rites.text: A spellcaster who unleashes harmful arcane force and can vanish from one spot and reappear at another during a clash. Such casters are prized for their sudden, unpredictable movement across the battlefield.

rites.name: Laulium
rites.text: A personal lightning rite in which a caster calls three bolts down from the sky in a row. The bolts are then steered onto one chosen foe, striking without mercy as if a blade of the heavens.

rites.name: Naules
rites.text: A protective craft used only by monstrous beasts, serving as the shielding power that most of them rely upon for their defense.

rites.name: Veones
rites.text: A passive gift of radiant pinions that belongs solely to one celestial guardian. It is a secondary craft that bends the heavens' brightness into a bearer's strength.

rites.name: Ciallania
rites.text: A learned craft of luminous healing and warding practiced by initiates of the old temples. Its adepts draw on gentle radiance to mend wounds and hold back dark forces.

rites.name: Rillanum
rites.text: A mounted fighting technique shared by beast riders, granting a steep boost to striking power. When it begins a clash, it weakens the opponent's guard and blunts their counterattack.

rites.name: Telintarnus
rites.text: A holy light craft called upon by a single caster, summoning a serene celestial presence through soft harp-like tones. It blinds a chosen foe and then raises upturned spears beneath them, and it can harm creatures of monstrous kind.

rites.name: Rianium Varneostes
rites.text: A bond of loyalty sworn between two companions that grants one of them a personal talent. The gift is held only by the one who made the pledge.

rites.name: Teleosum Lorniases
rites.text: A foul breath of rotted air that a creature exhales onto foes to wound them. It sharpens its user's strength greatly and strips away the defenses of the chosen target.

rites.name: Liarnaulus
rites.text: A chant-like gift that a trained singer can call upon to soften the blows of foes standing close by. Those attacks land with less force against the singer's companions.

rites.name: Ternus
rites.text: A fire craft that calls down a blazing radiance from the sky to burn a chosen foe to ash. Its caster also gains a hardened guard while the flames rage.

rites.name: Taurnes Neorus
rites.text: A keen inner attentiveness that lets its bearer sense peril before it arrives, granting a sizable bonus to evading harm. It is held only by a single scout who acts as the eyes and ears of a ruling commander.

rites.name: Telontia Sialles
rites.text: A martial calling reserved for one specific wanderer of a northern tribe. It belongs to a single bearer and marks her as a warrior bound to the pack.

rites.name: Valestor Saustanor
rites.text: A radiant incantation that calls down a shower of luminous force. It is found only in one particular tale of heroes.

rites.name: Amestes Veosillus
rites.text: A recurring battle technique that awakens when a fighter's life runs very low, sharply raising the chance of landing a decisive blow.

rites.name: Orosum
rites.text: A craft that lets a practitioner send a spreading blaze through the ground and air at once. It is passed down as a skill belonging to the ancient war-arts.

rites.name: Rilaria
rites.text: A learned sacred discipline that lets its practitioner turn aside incoming harm more readily. It is passed down among scholars of the healing and blessing arts.

rites.name: Valestinia
rites.text: A personal craft held by a single wanderer, it stays with them alone. Later it is passed on under a different name and symbol, yet keeps working the same way.

rites.name: Tiria
rites.text: A seasoned warrior's inborn talent that softens the blows a fighter takes while standing alongside a company of soldiers.

rites.name: Ameollisum
rites.text: A practiced technique of ranged strikes that binds a foe's voice and spell-wording for a single turn. Its mastery has been passed down through several different war-schools.

rites.name: Cinum
rites.text: A fighting technique practiced only by one hardy warrior caste, drawing power from the wind. A bond token passed between sworn allies also grants its wielder this same gust-born skill.

rites.name: Amesor
rites.text: A passive discipline that a warrior learns only after mastering an earlier guarding technique. When an enemy opens the clash, it steadies the bearer against magic and lets their charged arts recover faster with each blow.

rites.name: Cauntiasum
rites.text: A disciplined craft of gentle luminous power that a practitioner refines through study. It first appeared in a recent tale of war and three hopes.

rites.name: Telolanum
rites.text: A ceremonial breath-art wielded by one revered bearer, releasing a golden haze that scatters blossoms and silver sparks. Each strike also fills the surrounding air with drifting petals.

rites.name: Sevsyuzeth
rites.text: Sevsyuzeth is the concept of a dormant power that the makers of Nueriel sow into the Weave during the Seeding, a quiet force that lies asleep until its bearers call it forth. In the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke the old bonds between peoples and their lands, Sevsyuzeth became the thread that many tried to pull back together.

rites.name: Maurnontia
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by warriors of the wider hall. It is a fighting art that channels a strike into a numbing, stilling blow.

rites.name: Serarium
rites.text: A learned endurance craft that hardens a bearer against harm and exhaustion. It is taught through discipline and grows stronger with practice.

rites.name: Coranintia
rites.text: A passive discipline that hardens the bearer against blows while dulling their own striking force. It can be taken up by certain soldiers without being passed down from a teacher.

rites.name: Leostalium
rites.text: A fighting discipline of enchanted flame, practiced by spellcasters who channel heat into battle. It is reserved for a single tradition of wielders in one distant realm.

rites.name: Celia
rites.text: A dark sorcery used only by monstrous beasts, it traps a chosen foe inside a black sphere. Jagged bolts strike the sphere until it becomes a spinning storm that bursts apart.

rites.name: Oroleoria
rites.text: A passive discipline a bearer can learn without any teaching lineage, granting steadier footing against blows. It is practiced by a single wandering tuned warrior.

rites.name: Telalium
rites.text: A healer's craft that, when a staff mends a companion, lifts the swiftness and guard of every ally for one turn. A single caster learns it without passing it down from a teacher.

rites.name: Ameollanum
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a warrior who endures a clash amplify the spirit energy gained by every beast-kin fighter present. It can be learned by a gifted young fighter without inheriting it from a teacher.

rites.name: Tenes
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a practitioner of shadowed arts extend the distance at which their sorcery can strike. It is taught among the sworn schools of the ruined east.

rites.name: Sereleosor
rites.text: A learned technique that a fighter invokes to strip away an opponent's defensive ward and cut in half the chance that their blows land for one turn.

rites.name: Lasus
rites.text: A protective ward that only certain fearsome beasts can wield, serving as the defensive barrier of some of them. It shields its bearer against magical harm.

rites.name: Cereontes
rites.text: A dishonorable fighting art that a warrior learns to strike from unexpected angles. It has spread into a second contest where it aids allies in short bursts.

rites.name: Serentaunus
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a combatant hurls a shard of cold, rigid force along a straight line. It is taught as a discipline within some martial schools.

rites.name: Malum
rites.text: A bloodline gift carried by one young heir, allowing that person to draw on an ancient inherited power. It belongs to a single individual alone.

rites.name: Corialia
rites.text: A physical fighting discipline in which warriors wage battle while riding a war carriage. It was introduced in a sweeping saga of kingdoms and fates.

rites.name: Mauranum
rites.text: A quiet ward-craft that hardens nearby creatures of the wild, lending them extra guarding strength and steadiness at the start of every turn. It can be taught to a student without any inheritance of blood or lineage.

rites.name: Taraullus
rites.text: A passive combat technique that can be learned by a warrior without inheriting it from another. It is taught by a particular duo of fighters on a holy day.

rites.name: Maules
rites.text: A personal knack held by one wanderer that lets them move with dazzling, nimble steps. It is a trait specific to a single individual.

rites.name: Riarontum
rites.text: A mounted fighting discipline in which riders on winged steeds wield spears and blades. It is a later advancement of an older aerial riding craft.

rites.name: Contelor
rites.text: A learned technique that channels shadowy power in battle. It first appears in a combat-focused tale of three rival paths.

rites.name: Vaules
rites.text: A hexing technique wielded by a single gifted caster in a battle-chronicle. It is a unique action that drives foes away through a dark curse.

rites.name: Serarium Maulanum
rites.text: A fighting discipline practiced by a single gifted warrior who wields a long spear on foot. Its practitioners advance by mastering the lance in close combat.

rites.name: Telanor
rites.text: A devastating strike that overwhelms a foe in a single blow. It appears as a newly introduced attack in a sword-and-shield style combat tradition.

rites.name: Oraunium
rites.text: A learned art that a warrior can practice to gain a sudden burst of extra effort. It first appeared in a chronicle of a long, divided campaign.

rites.name: Naurnares
rites.text: A hidden inner gift that wakes in a warrior who has fully mastered a sacred knightly calling. It lies dormant until the bearer earns the discipline to call it forth.

rites.name: Telineores
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by warriors who hurl heavy bolts from a great engine. It is taught as a formal martial art among the soldiers of the realm.

rites.name: Neria
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a bearer move two extra paces while travelling bound alongside a partner. Winged riders master it once they have trained to the fifth rank.

rites.name: Vanausium
rites.text: A learned fighting technique that lets a warrior move with graceful rhythm through a duel. It later returns as a lasting passive art that sharpens the strikes of those who master it.

rites.name: Lorantia
rites.text: A dark craft that lets a practitioner channel a bane-laced force through their body. It first appeared in a sweeping tale of rival noble houses.

rites.name: Lanor
rites.text: A combat calling used by rulers who oppose the heroes, typically wielding long spears in heavy armor. Those who take it up can later be chosen as a leader's advanced path.

rites.name: Tostia
rites.text: A fiery exhalation technique that a fighter can unleash to strike an opponent and leave them reeling. It first appears among the battle arts taught in a sundered kingdom's war academies.

rites.name: Vornum
rites.text: A martial discipline that a fighter learns to strike the ground with such force that it tears open. It is practiced as a combat technique in the wider world.

rites.name: Leolanor
rites.text: A shifting current of water-craft that a cleric-like ally can invoke to aid a companion in battle. It belongs to a single gifted practitioner who has attuned herself to the tides.

rites.name: Liastia
rites.text: A practiced technique in which a warrior lands a guaranteed hit against an opponent. It first emerged in a later era of martial traditions.

rites.name: Seostia
rites.text: A forceful strike delivered with a bracing grip that shatters a foe's guard. It first emerges in a tactical combat tradition of an invented realm.

rites.name: Ventium
rites.text: A ruthless combat technique reserved for a select circle of fighters, favored for its brutal and decisive finish. It exists only among those who have been granted the right to wield it.

rites.name: Valintes
rites.text: A bearer's gauntleted strikes are empowered by a sense of righteous purpose. This craft is carried by a single fighter and used to aid allies in battle.

rites.name: Teleosus
rites.text: A dark-blue tome bound to a fallen sorceress, offering her a single hand-crafted spell to wield. It can only be carried by her, and no other bearer is recorded.

rites.name: Oriallia
rites.text: A sung chant that carries the sacred invocations of bound guardian sigils and recalls the realms they protect. It also remembers a later calamity and the newer sigils gathered in its wake.

rites.name: Rallum
rites.text: A passive discipline that hardens the bearer against blows and sorcery alike, though it dulls their own striking force. Any wanderer may learn it by sheer study, without a teacher's bloodline.

rites.name: Oraulleoses
rites.text: A disciplined fighting method in which a warrior channels all attention into one decisive blow. It is taught as a formal martial art among soldiers.

rites.name: Oriales
rites.text: A quiet inner craft that sharpens a fighter's aim for decisive blows at the start of each round, but only once their life has dwindled to a quarter or less.

rites.name: Lostia
rites.text: A personal talent carried by one warrior, letting them act with strong resolve alongside a chosen companion. It is a skill tied to a single individual's character.

rites.name: Ceollus
rites.text: A combat craft that lets its wielder take on the form and fighting style of a chosen companion. It belongs to one ancient dragon-born elder who can call upon it through a special act of mimicry.

rites.name: Naulium
rites.text: A quiet inner gift that lets its bearer drift into waking reverie, slipping briefly into a private world of visions. It belongs to a single dreamy wanderer and no one else.

rites.name: Leontialum
rites.text: A learned craft of shadow-sorcerers that sharpens a deadly technique, allowing the robed casters of a dark order to strike with greater lethal force.

rites.name: Amestiarium
rites.text: A paired striking technique where a warrior swings two weapons in a wide arc to unleash a fury of blows. It is taught as a fighting art within a combat tradition.

rites.name: Vintium
rites.text: A spinning shot technique that a skilled archer draws from the bow. It is a combat art passed down among warriors who train with ranged weapons.

rites.name: Corisalanum
rites.text: A grim fighting discipline reserved for a single bearer whose true identity remains concealed. It belongs to one hidden figure and cannot be taken up by others.

rites.name: Telaleorium
rites.text: A wielder can take on a great winged serpent's shape while bonded to a certain ancient spirit. The transformation grants a special power that is only available through that bond.

rites.name: Rarus
rites.text: A learned discipline of shadowy sorcery that a practitioner can perfect over time. It first emerged in a recent war-torn chronicle of warriors and kingdoms.

rites.name: Telileosum
rites.text: A personal craft held by one particular healer-maiden of the Ember Court, who draws surging vigor into herself during battle. It gives her rallying strength beyond ordinary reach.

rites.name: Telirnes
rites.text: A set of martial techniques that a warrior may draw upon while bonded to one of three legendary spirit guardians. The guardians grant access to the discipline only to those they have chosen.

rites.name: Amalonium
rites.text: A passive art that a bold wanderer can learn without receiving it through inheritance. It belongs to a class of quiet, always-active techniques.

rites.name: Vantaules
rites.text: A passive combat discipline that only heavily plated warriors can pass on to their apprentices. It stirs bold resolve in those who wear the heaviest armor.

rites.name: Vistalus
rites.text: A passive craft that quietly strengthens the arm of a fighter whenever their life has dwindled to a quarter or less, granting extra force at the start of each turn.

rites.name: Serellanes
rites.text: A melody sung by a traveling performer that carries a yearning to rise on the wind. It is voiced by a young singer whose tune drifts over the ridges of the valley.

rites.name: Neoselium
rites.text: A quiet inherited gift that a fallen bearer grants to those who follow. It works silently in the background and belongs to a single lost champion.

rites.name: Sillia Veosianus
rites.text: A green tome that summons a swirling barrier of water and bubbles, which then bursts upward into a towering column. Its wielder is marked by sea-bright trinkets like fish, fruit, and blossoms.

rites.name: Serantanum
rites.text: A ward-craft that turns thrown projectiles aside from its bearer. It is inscribed as a sealed rite, letting a warrior bat away incoming ranged strikes.

rites.name: Sosanum
rites.text: A dark sovereign's calling, reserved for a single ruler who wields it in the opening trials and during the first stage of a later siege.

rites.name: Coreontes
rites.text: A quiet ward-craft that, on every second turn, clears all lingering burdens from the caster and mends a little hurt for companions standing close by. Only attendants trained in healing arts can pass it on to their apprentices.

rites.name: Amarium
rites.text: A fiery breath technique wielded by a single bearer, a weapon skill that no one else in the realm can perform. It draws on a scorching, infernal exhalation.

rites.name: Coreosum
rites.text: A dark-aligned incantation of reasoned craft that conjures a barrage of shadowy barbs. It hits mounted riders with extra force.

rites.name: Niarausor
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a warrior pulls back immediately after striking, creating distance from an enemy. It is taught as a combat art among duelists and soldiers.

rites.name: Taurnum
rites.text: A reflexive knack that quickens the bearer's footwork each time an enemy strikes at them. It can be taught to a few trained fighters without being passed down by blood.

rites.name: Malor
rites.text: A sacred power wielded only by a single revered sovereign figure. It acts as a protective barrier that shields its bearer during a grand contest.

rites.name: Calloranum
rites.text: A protective craft that cuts incoming harm in half and blocks counterstrikes and creeping venom. It is weaker than the hardened-hide art, since it leaves deadly blows and piercing strikes untouched, yet no force can ever chip away at its halving.

rites.name: Serauranum
rites.text: A learned bond of guarding that makes a paired companion more likely to step between a blow and their partner. Only the second of two warriors can call on it, so it never builds upon itself.

rites.name: Sialanes
rites.text: A ferocious flame-bearing strike that a bonded champion unleashes at the call of a sworn ally. It stands beside a companion technique of shared resonance.

rites.name: Tarausanum
rites.text: A special class of enchantments and techniques that channels raw power into hidden forces. It is recorded across several chronicles of a shared lineage of warring realms.

rites.name: Vosania
rites.text: A shadowed art that a practitioner can draw upon to strike with dark power. It is studied and used by those who have learned its forbidden craft.

rites.name: Amastiarus
rites.text: A combat craft that a wielder reaches after advancing from an unnamed earlier discipline. Only one chosen fighter may practice it, relying solely on blades and stones.

rites.name: Vintolus
rites.text: A noble bearing that a person of high standing carries, granting them a particular lasting strength. It also serves as a special bond with a companion who shares that bearing.

rites.name: Telaror
rites.text: A bequeathed battle technique passed down to one bearer from a holy warrior. It can only be wielded by that single exclusive champion.

rites.name: Lintus
rites.text: A personal guardian craft held by one singular warrior, shielding its bearer from dark threats. It is also taught as a minor passive knack for lesser practitioners.

rites.name: Vaulases
rites.text: A mounted battle discipline in which a rider channels spell-books while charging into combat. It is reserved for one chosen wielder who has advanced beyond the standard path.

rites.name: Valintenor
rites.text: A precise style of swordplay that favors quick footwork and exact strikes over brute force. Practitioners train it to read an opponent's guard and slip through openings.

rites.name: Selor
rites.text: A combat discipline known only to one bearer, who calls on it in battle. Its arts are reserved for a single lineage and cannot be taught to outsiders.

rites.name: Lirnor
rites.text: A recurring technique first revealed in a later tale of war. It is practiced by those who turn their skill in cycles.

rites.name: Tonaurnium
rites.text: A bond-craft in which two companions who spar with one another grow stronger together. It can only be invoked by a bearer who wears a certain linked band of braided charms.

rites.name: Nastilium
rites.text: A quiet, unending gift of endurance that a single exalted figure carries and passively bestows. No other bearer of this craft can ever wield it.

rites.name: Tarnes Serallum
rites.text: A fearsome presence that can be drawn upon while bonded to a particular ancestral champion. It lets its wielder command dread that stirs within the bond.

rites.name: Saulus
rites.text: A caster calls down a barrage of crackling bolts that strike every foe near them. Its ferocity is so great that it can be unleashed only every second round.

rites.name: Valaulium Nistaures
rites.text: A healing craft in which a caregiver mending a companion with a staff briefly strengthens the striking and guarding power of every ally nearby for one turn. One warrior among the field troops learns it without needing to inherit it.

rites.name: Nestor
rites.text: A ritual by which a bearer rises from their present calling into a higher, more advanced calling. It is distinct from a simple change of role.

rites.name: Liasentum
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a warrior strikes an opponent and siphons away some of their stamina. It is taught to those who train in the martial arts of a far-off guild.

rites.name: Nialaranum
rites.text: A bonded healing art that draws harmful poisons out of a companion's body. It can only be performed by a wearer of a sister's gilded charm.

rites.name: Seosum
rites.text: A combat discipline blending blade work with five elemental arts: flame, gale, lightning, radiance, and steel. It belongs to one particular wanderer who wields all of them at once.

rites.name: Sereostium Teleosum
rites.text: A quiet discipline that lets scholars of the green books gather more learning from each trial, so long as they walk away from it alive.

rites.name: Sonernes
rites.text: A bearer's gift that quickens how swiftly they gain learning from every trial. Later refined, it also hardens the bearer against harm whenever they choose to hold still rather than act.

rites.name: Riallires
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets heavily armored companions standing nearby strike harder and move more quickly while the fighting is underway.

rites.name: Raurniastes
rites.text: A bloodline-born talent granted to one legendary champion alone. It is a special inherited skill that only that single famed warrior is able to wield.

rites.name: Tenteonus
rites.text: A passive art belonging to one particular sworn wielder, it returns later as a quiet inherited technique among a second warrior's battle habits.

rites.name: Rauntialium
rites.text: A fighting technique that appears as a trained combat skill within a warrior's repertoire. It is practiced across several arenas of contest and training.

rites.name: Lirnor Serastum
rites.text: A dark working summons the spirit of a vast serpent that coils around a chosen foe, turning them to stone and draining their vitality to heal the caster. It is swift to cast and rarely misses its mark.

rites.name: Varium
rites.text: A passive discipline that a hardened warrior may learn on their own, and which only units clad in heavy plating can pass along to others.

rites.name: Lontium
rites.text: A cunning technique that hardens its user's guard and doubles nearby allies' visible strengths. When the user stands beside beasts or dragons, or stands alone, it grants a sharp surge of offense and turns follow-up strikes back on attackers.

rites.name: Serarnum Vaustum
rites.text: A passive guard that lets a bearer who is normally vulnerable to riders' killing blows take their full force without added harm. Only a few heirs of a certain bloodline can learn it.

rites.name: Vaulor
rites.text: A passive discipline carried only by one armored champion of the vanguard. It is an inherited oath-bond that quietly strengthens the bearer's resolve in battle.

rites.name: Nariastor
rites.text: A guarding craft passed among steel-clad companions that sharpens the strike and quickens the stride of those standing close beside it at each new dawn of battle.

rites.name: Veoles
rites.text: A combat technique a warrior may use while wearing a sacred band of office. It is also taught as a leader's tactic and later passes to a single fighter as a personal trait.

rites.name: Saunisium
rites.text: A combat discipline in which a fighter channels a chilling force through a blade to strike foes. It is practiced as a martial art in a world of warring houses.

rites.name: Coriarnium
rites.text: A fighting style where a warrior rides atop a wild scaled beast and strikes with blades or heavy hooked cleavers. Only one fearsome rider is known to command this method in battle.

rites.name: Riliarnes
rites.text: A martial calling reserved for two specific nobles, first practiced on horseback and later on foot. Its practitioners wield blades, and in later forms also spears and the weight of command.

rites.name: Oreorium
rites.text: A sharp inner sense that lets a person read the unspoken truth behind words and situations. It is a learned ability honed through close observation and attentive thought.

rites.name: Conum
rites.text: A bearer's sovereign strength is lent to a companion in battle, a unique aid drawn from a ruler's presence. It belongs to one particular fighter alone.

rites.name: Sarnor
rites.text: A fighting technique that grants a random outcome on each strike, sometimes dealing a standard damaging blow despite what the wielder's instructions suggest.

rites.name: Valeorum
rites.text: A heavily armored warrior who fights from horseback with brute physical force. This martial craft recurs in many chronicles of the realm, first appearing in an early saga of holy wars.

rites.name: Amiallia
rites.text: A mounted riding craft that spurs nearby horse-borne fighters to strike harder and move faster in the heat of battle. Only a few warriors can teach it to others without passing it down through blood.

rites.name: Nausoria
rites.text: A hidden innate gift that a warrior awakens after mastering a dragon-rider calling. It lets a fighter of certain bloodlines strike with crushing force.

rites.name: Amiasus
rites.text: A heavy fighting discipline in which a trained warrior, promoted from a mounted guard, wields long spears. The practitioner excels at striking hard and holding firm, yet moves slowly across the field.

rites.name: Valanum
rites.text: A dormant craft that once blunted the strength of foot soldiers on a battlefield. Few practitioners remember how it was meant to be used, and it is now left unused.

rites.name: Telasia
rites.text: A dark working drawn from the mind's own reasoning, sitting at the highest rung of forbidden arts that a practitioner can wield. It stands as the most potent shadowed rite available to those who study it.

rites.name: Valiseonia
rites.text: A bearer's inherited gift quickens how fast they learn from battle. An enhanced form lets them slip through foes' ranks as if unseen.

rites.name: Telestium
rites.text: A keen blade-skill that lets its wielder strike again against foes still at full strength. It also sharpens attack power and grants a flying form with added reach across the field.

rites.name: Seollium
rites.text: A learned art of bending the passage of days, carried by those who bear a sealed token of ancient rites. It is passed from one practitioner to the next through quiet instruction.

rites.name: Viantia
rites.text: A discipline of combat-trained casters who channel radiant energy into spells and strikes on the battlefield. It is practiced by those who wield luminous magic in open warfare.

rites.name: Melaria
rites.text: A green-aligned spell craft that a single wielder can channel. It is bound to one particular armament that only a single named practitioner is able to carry.

rites.name: Corelanium
rites.text: A piercing stare that a single bearer can call upon to turn a chosen foe to stone for the remainder of a struggle. Only one person in the lineage holds this power.

rites.name: Oraurium Seriarnum
rites.text: A discipline of honor that a single wandering warrior carries as a personal gift. It is a skill passed through one bearer, shaping how she fights and conducts herself.

rites.name: Selor Valernolia
rites.text: A personal gift that a warrior carries from one tale to the next. It was first held by a sky-dancer and was later passed on to a gentle giant who shares its benefits in battle.

rites.name: Coreostum
rites.text: A disciplined craft of channeling radiant force into battle spells. Practitioners train within orders that treat luminous power as a tool for war.

rites.name: Oriastilum
rites.text: A quiet, passive discipline that a warrior can learn without being taught it by a mentor. A few notable champions of the old orders are able to master it on their own.

rites.name: Teolium
