rites.text: A forceful strike in a warrior's craft that knocks an opponent off balance. It is first recorded in a tale of the Three Houses.

rites.name: Caurnum
rites.text: A fighting discipline in which warriors ride winged serpent-beasts into close battle with hand weapons. Only one people among the realm's peoples practices it.

rites.name: Centiarum
rites.text: A mounted warrior who fights with a long piercing spear from horseback. This fighting style first emerged in an ancient epic of holy conflict.

rites.name: Morum
rites.text: A restorative craft in which a healer's staff work mends a companion. Each mend also returns a small measure of vitality to every other ally in the circle.

rites.name: Sernor
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline carried by a single wandering swordsman. It is a personal trait that also grants a special battlefield technique in later tellings of his story.

rites.name: Rauntor
rites.text: A deep strike that a fighter unleashes in combat. It was first recorded in a later chronicle of a war between two rival realms.

rites.name: Corilernium
rites.text: A spontaneous craft that a single performer can wield without preparation. It appears as a helpful aid in later works and belongs to one particular practitioner.

rites.name: Meorum Orosaullum
rites.text: A passive craft that an inheriting warrior can learn without being taught it by a mentor. It grants a defensive benefit to the one who has mastered it.

rites.name: Mostasia
rites.text: A binding craft that locks a foe's limbs in place so they cannot move. It is used only by enemies against their opponents in battle.

rites.name: Valoneolium
rites.text: A passive craft that only creatures of draconic breath can pass down to their kin. A chosen warrior may also learn it without inheritance, granting a defensive ward.

rites.name: Seroranum Oreostarnus
rites.text: A personal skill known to one wandering archer. It lets its holder ambush travelers on the open road.

rites.name: Naurneorium
rites.text: A fighting technique practiced by armored guards within enclosed halls. It sharpens a warrior's aim and evasion whenever combat takes place inside a building, and it is taught to sworn protectors once they reach a certain level of training.

rites.name: Oreonelor
rites.text: A martial craft in which a warrior wields a long spear with fiery force. It was first recorded in a tale of a gathering of rival houses.

rites.name: Veosiarnes
rites.text: A chilling art of conjuring a reflective sheet of ice that a single wielder alone can summon. It belongs solely to one particular practitioner and cannot be taught to others.

rites.name: Amausium
rites.text: A bowman's trained technique that unleashes a sweeping volley of air-borne arrows. It belongs to a single archer and is her defining martial method.

rites.name: Coriantus
rites.text: A commander's sharp judgment that lifts the fighting spirit of allies stationed nearby. It is a gift carried by a single gifted strategist, reflecting their skill in guiding others.

rites.name: Oristallor
rites.text: A sacred chant passed through one bloodline, sung to unseal a slumbering deity bound within a holy relic. Its melody and words are kept secret by the rightful singers.

rites.name: Santisum
rites.text: A rare inborn talent granted to a select few wielders of a unique spell-craft. It belongs only to two bearers who share one lineage of practice.

rites.name: Valeorneres
rites.text: A shared ward that a bearer may call upon after joining wills with a sacred band, turning aside the foes whose strikes are meant to wound the one who holds it.

rites.name: Valiarnia
rites.text: A rare inborn gift of far sight that lets its holder read an opponent's movements more surely and see farther across shrouded terrain. One bearer is born with it and cannot set it aside.

rites.name: Rilia
rites.text: A quick battle tactic in which a nearby companion gains five extra steps of movement while stood beside the one who readies it.

rites.name: Nialia
rites.text: A ruthless strike technique taught to warriors, used to break through an opponent's head protection with a single heavy blow.

rites.name: Oraunanum
rites.text: A combat discipline that channels a tempest into a warrior's strike, letting a fighter carry storm-born force through a blade. It is practiced as a martial art of the battlefield.

rites.name: Oriallastum
rites.text: A learned discipline that a warrior can invoke to smother the extra harm carried by a weapon. While it holds, edges and arrows strike with only their plain force, cancelling the special advantage they would otherwise gain against flying foes.

rites.name: Coralor
rites.text: A learned craft for enduring peril that one particular wanderer carries as a private gift. It is taught and held by a single named person.

rites.name: Telestia Nastanum
rites.text: A innate talent that grants a unique support bond to a particular fighter in a squad of battle-hardened allies. It lets that fighter aid comrades during the heat of combat.

rites.name: Marniasia
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a practitioner unleashes a burst of force against creatures. It is taught as a discipline among warriors of the realm.

rites.name: Vauntia Neres
rites.text: A rare technique that can be passed to qualified fighters, granting special strikes with unique flourishes and enhanced force. It is taught only through specific rites or rare tokens.

rites.name: Nales
rites.text: A combat discipline in which a fighter channels sudden storm energy through the hands to deliver strikes. It is practiced as a martial art among warriors of the realm.

rites.name: Teliseolium
rites.text: A coaxing gift of allure that a fearsome creature wields over those around her. It draws onlookers closer and softens their guard during encounters.

rites.name: Maronus
rites.text: A high-tier tome of gathered radiance that draws drifting energy into the center of a battlefield. The swirling light swells into a sphere that finally bursts, hurling a barrage of luminous spikes at a chosen foe.

rites.name: Launastum
rites.text: A tactical craft in which a fighter steadies a neighboring companion, raising their striking force and inner guard by three until the turn concludes.

rites.name: Mentes Ameonia
rites.text: A fighting discipline that lets a warrior strike deep into beasts of great size. It is practiced as a form of combat art within a martial tradition.

rites.name: Corestia
rites.text: A fighting discipline in which warriors ride winged mounts through the air while striking with blades. It arose when an older mounted order was divided into three separate paths, and a warrior can only take it up later by changing their training.

rites.name: Valontor
rites.text: A learned craft that lets its practitioner gain twice the usual advantage from their natural rhythms of body and spirit. It is passed between those who train patiently in balance.

rites.name: Serentonor
rites.text: A savage war-form that a fighter can take on to wield a brutal weapon. It belongs to a set of such grim transformations.

rites.name: Vilernus
rites.text: A calming craft in which a healer draws on a still pool's quiet to fortify every companion for a short while whenever a staff mends a wounded friend.

rites.name: Nirnia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline practiced by one wandering scout-healer, who draws steady focus from it. It is a personal art that belongs only to her.

rites.name: Orasus Siasauntum
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a warrior channels force through a weapon to break an opponent's guard. It has been taught and passed on through several generations of combatants.

rites.name: Amerum Tiasanum
rites.text: A signature move that lets one fighter march across the battlefield at full stride, unique to a single warrior and used to cover great ground swiftly.

rites.name: Riastanor
rites.text: A fighting discipline in which a trained warrior wields a blade as the sole weapon. Once the signature training of a famed swordsman, it can later be passed to any male student who earns a special sigil.

rites.name: Telaunum
rites.text: A standing advantage gained by occupying certain kinds of ground, which weakens blows aimed at the one who holds that footing. Sometimes it instead sharpens the strikes of the holder.

rites.name: Lostenus
rites.text: A crushing strike in which a stream of radiant spears batters an enemy, leaving them reeling. It is a heavy blow meant to overwhelm an opponent.

rites.name: Cialium Amiallum
rites.text: A radiant chant unique to one healer in a battle-sorcery realm. It is a special action that empowers the caster.

rites.name: Corenium
rites.text: A fighting discipline in which the practitioner unleashes wide, arcing strikes born of rising anger. It is taught as a martial craft within the armed circles of a sundered realm.

rites.name: Meolarnanum
rites.text: A bond-tracking craft that grows between companions who fight side by side. Its early form later branches into the trust, union and heirs found in several succeeding rites.

rites.name: Valernaurum
rites.text: A learned talent for handling edged weapons with skill. It is cultivated through practice and grants a warrior greater mastery in combat.

rites.name: Vilium Mestiallia
rites.text: A passive craft that stirs fear in a rival whose strength falls below the bearer's own while it stands beside another foe. The frightened rival has its gathered blessings turned into burdens.

rites.name: Lanus
rites.text: A practiced craft by which a fighter siphons good fortune from a foe. It returns in a later tale under a different wording of the same art.

rites.name: Orinestus
rites.text: A combat discipline in which a warrior channels arcane force through a bladed weapon. It is taught as a fighting art and used in battle.

rites.name: Tiallanum Valernes
rites.text: A learned knack that lets a certain warrior narrowly avoid a blow that should have landed. It belongs to one specific fighter and is tied to that person alone.

rites.name: Lirus
rites.text: A mounted flying fighting style wielded by a crown heir who rides a winged steed. Her blades and staves are her chosen tools, though archers and gales can bring her down.

rites.name: Orostum Nauses
rites.text: A practiced technique in which a warrior moves through drifting fog without being seen. It lets the user strike unnoticed from the haze.

rites.name: Coreosellor
rites.text: A special gift that belongs only to one kind of luminous spirit. It is a rare art that lets its holder endure without end.

rites.name: Ceosauria
rites.text: A hidden measure of fortune that each bearer carries, quietly sharpening or easing their chances. It can grow a little whenever a bearer rises in skill and experience.

rites.name: Nirium
rites.text: A bracing craft that lets a nearby companion harden their guard against blows and spells for the rest of the round. A stronger version of the same craft grants even greater hardening.

rites.name: Valonesum
rites.text: A dark, inherited sovereign discipline that sharpens the chance of invoking a ruler's inner power. Only a few tyrants and their servants can wield its fuller, stronger form.

rites.name: Ceonausum
rites.text: A battle discipline reserved for hostile warriors, practiced only by a single ruler who wields heavy cleaving blades. It is a fighting style of brute martial force.

rites.name: Sernus
rites.text: A passive craft that raises the strength and guard of a fighter who opens a clash. Several champions across the realm may learn it without passing it down from a mentor.

rites.name: Corenolia
rites.text: A passive discipline a warrior may acquire without training under a teacher. It is passed on through a single lineage of inherited knowledge.

rites.name: Orillium Orolleontia
rites.text: A mounted fighting craft practiced by two counterpart riders who each master either blade or spellbook. Their wyvern steeds let them combine close strikes with arcane tomes.

rites.name: Sasia Nonteoses
rites.text: A dark, unsettling force that clings to a bearer like a sinister halo. It is a skill that can be drawn upon in a battle.

rites.name: Montus
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a practitioner shield their allies or themselves by drawing a protective cloak of force. It first appeared in the chronicles of a long-ago war.

rites.name: Resor
rites.text: A personal talent that lets one particular wielder turn an apparently lost fight around at the last moment. It belongs to a single chosen fighter.

rites.name: Valostauror
rites.text: A flowing radiance that a fighter can call upon during a battle. It belongs to the arts of the fighting orders.

rites.name: Cistanum
rites.text: A ceremonial craft in which a noble performs grand public display to lift the spirits of allies. It first appeared in the rise of a stormy court cycle.

rites.name: Rentostus
rites.text: A quiet passive craft that, on every second cycle of turns, lifts all burdens from the bearer and mends a little of the wounds of nearby comrades. Only those who tend and bind others may inherit its use.

rites.name: Celontanum
rites.text: A passive craft that stirs a bearer's strength and that of nearby allies on every second turn. Certain wielders can learn it directly without passing it down.

rites.name: Oraurnum
rites.text: A quiet passive craft that silences lingering afflictions and strikes that keep a foe from answering blows. Only foot soldiers can carry its lesson forward, and a reflected echo of it may also awaken.

rites.name: Reoranum Meolastia
rites.text: A signature combat technique belonging to one warrior, letting her call down a rapid burst of storm energy during battle. It marks her as a unique fighter whose skill is tied to a single personal style.

rites.name: Taunum
rites.text: A fighting technique of the battlefield that tears through foes with rapid, cutting strokes. It is practiced by warriors who train in its disciplined forms.

rites.name: Relles
rites.text: A reflexive inner sense that lets a single wanderer feel danger coming and act on it before others notice. It belongs to one person alone and shows up both in everyday survival and in moments of shared battle.

rites.name: Sirum
rites.text: A flaming technique that only one wandering swordsman has mastered. The skill passes between generations of his order in later chronicles of the same world.

rites.name: Orellia Tistelium
rites.text: A borrowed battle discipline in which a fighter stands beside a companion and lends steady strength and guard for the remainder of the current round.

rites.name: Naustinia
rites.text: A swift martial technique in which a fighter links two rapid strikes into one flowing sequence. It is practiced as a combat discipline.

rites.name: Niantes Coriaseonor
rites.text: A swift technique first taught alongside a great winged creature. Its practitioners move with startling agility, and it was recorded as the lore of a single ancient flier.

rites.name: Coreolor
rites.text: A fighting discipline in which practitioners strike down great beasts. It is taught as a technique of combat meant for the hunting of monsters.

rites.name: Telistarnes
rites.text: A focused inner discipline held by a single wielder, granting them a steadfast resolve. An alternate bearer of the same discipline knows it under a different name.

rites.name: Serauntus
rites.text: A passive ward that lets its bearer weaken the swiftness and warding strength of every foe standing within two paces. Certain wanderers may learn it without any lineage or inheritance.

rites.name: Tirniallus
rites.text: A learned combat discipline that one warrior has mastered. It sharpens the bearer's fighting skill in battle.

rites.name: Rerastus
rites.text: A martial discipline in which a warrior channels raw physical force into overwhelming strikes. It is taught in a single fighting tradition of the wider realm.

rites.name: Orerialium
rites.text: A ward-craft that only the sky-born serpent kin can channel. It sharpens the arcane strength and quickness of companions standing close beside the caster.

rites.name: Saurantanum
rites.text: A learned gift that lets its bearer resist having their speech or spellcasting stripped away. Only foes wielding it hold this protection.

rites.name: Saseornanum
rites.text: A personal talent held by one wandering scholar of the mist-hall orders, allowing her to see through disguises. She keeps the gift quietly, using it to unveil hidden faces.

rites.name: Rostia
rites.text: A mournful chant sung by a gentle winged maiden, insisting that the surrounding realm is genuine and not a deception. It is performed as a song meant to reassure listeners about the reality of their world.

rites.name: Villanum
rites.text: A fiery craft is held by a single practitioner, who alone can unleash it. It belongs to one named wielder and can be used by no one else.

rites.name: Saunium
rites.text: A signature combat technique wielded by a single warrior, unleashed as a sweeping burst of resonant force. It belongs to one named fighter alone and marks her as a unique battlefield presence.

rites.name: Corontarum
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a fighter slip past the sorcery hurled at them. It first appeared in an early chronicle under a different label and has since turned up in later tellings.

rites.name: Ameosantium Ciasiles
rites.text: A tactical craft in which a fighter lands a sudden, unexpected blow. It first appears in a sundered realm's combat traditions.

rites.name: Vauntus Rialeonia
rites.text: A combat discipline of spellcasters who wield crackling lightning as their sole weapon. It splits off from a broader order of arcane users and is taught as one of three separate paths.

rites.name: Cistornum
rites.text: A battle-caster discipline that channels crackling skyfire into offensive spells. Only a single tradition of practitioners has ever mastered its arts.

rites.name: Orauniallia
rites.text: A quiet fighting craft that blends close combat with practical utility skills. It is practiced by wanderers who favor steel over spells and move without drawing attention.

rites.name: Oreniallia
rites.text: A whirling strike technique found in the battle-craft of a warrior tradition. It is performed in combat and belongs to the martial arts practised by the fighters of that realm.

rites.name: Teleolistus
rites.text: A tactical craft that lets a fighter strike first when an opponent would normally have launched the opening blow. It is passed among warriors who learned to read an enemy's approach.

rites.name: Telauntus Nestalium
rites.text: A fighting craft in which a lesser warrior gains strength against a foe of higher standing. The weaker one's blows grow heavier the more the opponent outranks them.

rites.name: Telarium Serisanum
rites.text: A bond-attunement that shapes how two companions strengthen one another, granting bonuses tied to their shared nature. It favors striking power but offers little protection, and it pairs poorly with some attunements while blending well with others.

rites.name: Corirnianus
rites.text: A cunning craft of reading opponents and slipping past defenses in battle. It first appeared in a tale of three rival banners.

rites.name: Telaustum
rites.text: A dual-strike technique held by a single fighter, unleashed as a signature special move. It marks the wielder's personal combat style within a larger battle.

rites.name: Cinteoses
rites.text: A quiet trained knack that a warrior can gain without being taught by a master, passed along by a pair of winter companions. It is a secondary discipline that shapes how the warrior fights.

rites.name: Vistanum Neonium
rites.text: A defensive technique taught to fighters in several training halls. Practitioners learn it through discipline rather than inheritance, and it can be passed along in stages to a student who has mastered its first form.

rites.name: Orillesanum
rites.text: A tactical maneuver used by mounted sky-riders to misdirect opponents. It first appears in a battle-focused tale of rival houses.

rites.name: Centiarnor Rausium
rites.text: A helpful aid technique that refreshes an ally's strength during battle. It is held only by a single brave dancer-warrior of the realm.

rites.name: Orareollium
rites.text: A learned craft of gentle, healing radiance that the practitioners of the realm refine over years. It was first set down in a later chronicle of martial traditions.

rites.name: Nentus Naleoses
rites.text: A passive art that lets a bearer step through the air to stand beside a nearby companion whenever that companion is badly wounded. Several bearers can learn it without special tutoring, and a lesser echoed form also exists.

rites.name: Valiantoses
rites.text: A learned craft that a shapeshifting folk can bind to themselves. It lets them partly change into their human form whenever they choose, strengthening their human abilities by half again, at a cost of fifteen points of effort.

rites.name: Caliranum
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a combatant loses force with each successive blow. It is taught as a skill that others may learn and use in battle.

rites.name: Coresiallus
rites.text: A dark hex that certain foes can cast, drawing on emptiness. It is used only by enemies and belongs to a sorcerous craft.

rites.name: Viasum
rites.text: A passive riders' discipline that steels mounted companions standing nearby, hardening their armor and wards during battle. Any rider who studies it may learn it without inheriting it from a teacher.

rites.name: Miarostia
rites.text: A rare fighting technique that a single winged warrior alone can perform. It can be passed down to foot soldiers who wield blades, spears, or heavy axes.

rites.name: Veostus Amesor
rites.text: A keen-sighted talent that lets a person notice what others miss. It belongs to a single wary archer and serves as his signature gift in two different tales.

rites.name: Rantia Rinastes
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a healer's luminous art extend a little farther across the field. It is a refinement passed among practitioners of restorative light.

rites.name: Veoriantia
rites.text: A bearer channels arcane force through distant heavenly fire and strikes one chosen foe with a crushing radiant blow. It can also harm creatures of monstrous kind, though its heavy burden slows the caster somewhat.

rites.name: Naurnes Amalosum
rites.text: A passive art that quickens a warrior's movements in battle whenever they hold a clear lead in vitality over their foe. Certain wanderers can learn it without a master's teaching.

rites.name: Telanor Valornestor
rites.text: A combined martial calling taught only to two royal siblings of a northern house. It blends the skills and weapon training of two advanced fighting paths with the bearing of their noble station.

rites.name: Nenaulor
rites.text: A martial discipline in which a fighter turns in a full circle, sweeping a blade around to strike every foe nearby. It is taught as a form of combat technique.

rites.name: Amosires
rites.text: A personal talent held by a single wanderer, letting them command the currents of the air. It marks them as a student of gusts and breezes.

rites.name: Corasentum
rites.text: A learned caster path that draws on the mind's reasoning to unleash forceful spells against foes. Practitioners also gain skill in mind-based and sacred workings.

rites.name: Valiastosum
rites.text: A fervent inner fire that sharpens a warrior's aim toward decisive blows. Fighters of sufficient experience learn to kindle it, gaining a measurable edge in striking true.

rites.name: Saulleostia
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter uses a sweeping motion to drive gusts of air against foes. It can be learned and drawn upon again in later trials of skill.

rites.name: Tariasanum
rites.text: A quiet inner gift that a single warrior carries into battle, granting a steady passive insight. No other fighter in the realm can learn it.

rites.name: Nestisia
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a warrior surrenders all restraint and strikes with reckless fury. It is taught and practiced as a formal discipline of combat.

rites.name: Orirnia Rialum
rites.text: A passive craft that hardens winged companions standing close by in battle, bolstering their guard against blows and spells. A certain warrior-rider may learn it without ever having been taught it by another.

rites.name: Tanirnor
rites.text: A passive safeguard that a single attuned caster carries within the order's lore. It belongs only to that one practitioner and shields the bearer quietly in battle.

rites.name: Corenisum
rites.text: A fierce combat technique that a warrior can learn and use in battle. It later reappears as a practiced fighting art taught among skilled fighters.

rites.name: Nolisium
rites.text: A combat discipline in which a warrior channels shadowy force through a thrusting weapon. It is practiced as a martial art within the wider world of combat techniques.

rites.name: Roliaria
rites.text: A mercenary's signature blast of pent-up force that erupts outward from the wielder's body. It is the default strike used by a sword-bearing sellsword in combat.

rites.name: Orantor
rites.text: A quiet craft that leaves a choking haze behind a fighter after a clash. Nearby enemies find their guard thinned when they move on their next turn.

rites.name: Rintia
rites.text: A quiet foresight gift that is passed down to a single bearer, letting them glimpse the coming moments before they unfold. It belongs to a pair of twin-bound seers who share the same ancient inheritance.

rites.name: Telonesium
rites.text: A pale blue sheaf of petals that drops from the heavens onto a foe and bursts apart, scattering blossoms outward. It quickens the bearer and nearby companions while they stand close together.

rites.name: Tellus
rites.text: A craft that strips the protective enchantment from a warded suit of plate, leaving its wearer exposed to ordinary blows. It is practiced by duelists who prefer subtle workings over open force.

rites.name: Neorium
rites.text: A healer's technique that lets the caster quicken and steady every companion for a single turn whenever a restorative rite is performed upon one ally.

rites.name: Orillium
rites.text: A tactical maneuver used in battle where a group of soldiers advances together to strike a target directly. It is first recorded in a recent campaign of the age of sundered houses.

rites.name: Telaliantus
rites.text: A passive knack that quickens a fighter's footwork, granting extra swiftness. When an opponent strikes the bearer, the gift briefly resets the rhythm of the bearer's next moves.

rites.name: Telauntium
rites.text: A swift martial technique that a fighter uses in battle to strike with sudden, blinding speed. It is taught through a single combat school of arms.

rites.name: Orauntastia
rites.text: A fading resonance that lingers faintly after a sound has passed, carried quietly by a passive gift. It marks the echo of a particular bearer who carries its tone.

rites.name: Ceonernia
rites.text: A practiced stillness of mind that sharpens a fighter's aim for deadly strikes when no companions stand close. Scholars of the arcane learn it once they have reached a seasoned level of training.

rites.name: Teostilium
rites.text: A bonded art in which a wielder and an ally pledge their strength to one another. Its practitioners draw on that shared pledge to set their deeds in motion.

rites.name: Niastor
rites.text: A learnable craft that lets a practitioner channel storm energy into their strikes. It first appears in a later tale of arms and banners.

rites.name: Seriarellum
rites.text: A passive art that a wielder can gain without inheriting it, granted through a particular crystal-forged relic. It counts as a lesser discipline within the craft of battle.

rites.name: Mantaurnor
rites.text: A learned craft that quiets the power of ancient scaled beasts, letting a wielder ignore their breath and fury. It was first recorded in a tale of rival academies.

rites.name: Mellaunus
rites.text: A passive craft that only heavily plated fighters can inherit, granting a secondary ability that follows the bearer's main actions. It is learned as a supporting technique in the warrior halls.

rites.name: Amastor
rites.text: A learned battle technique that a legendary male wielder can acquire without inheritance. It lets the user unleash a thunderous bellow in combat.

rites.name: Amestes
rites.text: A combat technique that sharpens a fighter's striking power whenever they are the one to open a clash. Warriors who train in a certain bold discipline are the ones who master it.

rites.name: Miantia
rites.text: A passive rhythmic technique that strengthens the swiftness and steadiness of any companion refreshed by the dancer's performance. It is taught to one individual without being passed down by lineage.

rites.name: Niarnium
rites.text: A quiet stance that weakens a foe's striking and guarding power while steadily building a bearer's readiness with each blow they receive, so long as the bearer remains sturdy or the opponent is already burdened. Only one particular wanderer can wield it.

rites.name: Valineostum
rites.text: A learned craft of shielding oneself and one's allies from blows. Practitioners train their stance and timing to turn aside incoming harm.

rites.name: Amornia
rites.text: A passive trick that a warrior learns for drawing foes out of position. When a companion's shifting maneuver is used, it weakens the enemy's armor and magical ward, and the foe is left open and unguarded.

rites.name: Amiantor
rites.text: A passive craft that lets its bearer move swifter at the start of each round once their life force has dwindled to a low threshold. Several named wanderers may learn it without inheriting it from a teacher.

rites.name: Oreolaunor
rites.text: A personal discipline that lessens the harm a warrior takes while fighting alone, away from the ranks of a company. It is a trait carried by a single wielder.

rites.name: Liastornus
rites.text: A rare inherited craft that lets a ruling shapeshifter hold their beast form indefinitely until they choose to return to human shape. It can pass from a dying sovereign to a chosen heir.

rites.name: Orirnanum
rites.text: A passive discipline that a warrior can learn without teaching, letting a bearer hold firm against both blows and hexes. It can be taken up by a restless sea-raider who sails beneath a crimson sky.

rites.name: Saniantor
rites.text: A trained art of defensive vigilance that lets a practitioner brace against incoming blows with unusual skill. It first appeared in a modern tactical training manual of the Ashmere Circle.

rites.name: Teloranum
rites.text: A quiet, steady craft that a warrior may acquire without tutoring, granting a standing endurance against blows. Certain wanderers of a festive company are known to have mastered it on their own.

rites.name: Serinor
rites.text: A passive craft that a warrior can learn without inheriting it from another. It grants a rush of heat-driven strength to those who master it.

rites.name: Valirum
rites.text: A healer's technique that lets a caregiver's restorative rite fortify every companion for one turn. Whenever a staff mends an ally, the whole group gains added guard against blows and spells.

rites.name: Toraustus
rites.text: A passive craft held only by serpent-blooded sages, quietly bound to one lineage. It works without being called upon, shaping the bearer's strikes from the background.

rites.name: Maurneosum
rites.text: A bound vow that hardens the bearer's guard against blows, a quiet discipline passed among sworn wardens of the marsh-cities.

rites.name: Valirnes
rites.text: A tactical maneuver that lets a bearer trade positions with an ally and gives that ally one extra action. The bearer may invoke it again, but the bonus action can only be granted once each turn. Only one particular warrior may master it, and it cannot be passed on.

rites.name: Amiriarnia
rites.text: A passive technique that a warrior can only master after first learning a lesser stance. Certain dragon beings can acquire it naturally without needing to inherit it from another.

rites.name: Caurasanum
rites.text: A bearer raises a pair of scaled wings from the back and rises into the open air. Anything caught in the rising gust is struck again and again, and steering the climb before lifting off changes how high the bearer travels.

rites.name: Vilium
rites.text: A fighting technique that channels crackling energy through the ground to strike foes. It is taught to warriors as a combat art.

rites.name: Amisanum
rites.text: A bonding attunement that grants lasting stat gains when paired companions grow close through shared trust. The gains depend on the attunements of both bonded partners, and one attunement is known for its strong dodge bonus at the highest bond level.

rites.name: Ameontum
rites.text: Two neighboring allies join forces in a clash, granting each other support boosts, extra strikes, and complete shielding from harm. Foes may adopt the same joined tactic as well.

rites.name: Valanilia
rites.text: A temporary weakening that drains a bearer's strength and resolve for a short span. It has grown more common across later generations of the craft.

rites.name: Tesarnor
rites.text: A quiet art of a dagger-bearer who steps onto a hidden snare, breaking it apart without ever springing its trigger. Only those wielding short blades may learn this passive discipline.

rites.name: Coneornum
rites.text: A quiet poisoned haze that a wielder can learn to carry without passing it down through family lineage. Only certain gifted figures are able to master it.

rites.name: Tiralus
rites.text: A craft of binding minor wonders into ordinary things, practiced by those who carry a sealed pouch of tricks. Its way of opening is granted only after a dark tale of the wilds is fully told.

rites.name: Nastum
rites.text: A passive discipline that hardens a warrior's spirit against magic whenever their vitality drops to half or less. Apprentices of certain schools can learn it without formal inheritance.

rites.name: Rausostum
rites.text: A passive combat discipline that sharpens a fighter's strike whenever an enemy lands a blow on them. Several warriors can learn it without any formal teaching.

rites.name: Corollaunus
rites.text: A quiet, always-on craft that lets a wielder endure harm from afar. It can be taught to a shadow-trained fighter without any family lineage.

rites.name: Rastia
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a warrior spins a fiery kick through the air. It was taught in a newer martial style known as Combat Art.

rites.name: Amenistanum
rites.text: A coordinated technique that a warrior may perform while wearing a particular ornamental band on the wrist. Two allied fighters link their gifts together to unleash a single finishing blow.

rites.name: Orillernium
rites.text: A fighter performs a sequence of four rapid sword strikes, and steering the guiding lever mid-sequence alters the path of each cut. The later strikes carry searing heat and one can hurl foes skyward.

rites.name: Vallium Amausirium
rites.text: A learned art that lets a practitioner glimpse the outcome of a coming action before it is taken. It first appeared in a battle-focused craft tradition.

rites.name: Amorum
rites.text: A shadowy craft that sharpens the strike of a practitioner's dark spells, granting a lasting bonus to their chance of landing a decisive blow.

rites.name: Melum
rites.text: A coordinated fighting technique in which two blows are delivered in rapid succession by a single warrior. It first appeared in a martial training tradition of the invented world.

rites.name: Oranum
rites.text: A measured spark of growth that builders gather through their deeds and trials. Enough of these sparks lets a builder grow stronger in their craft.

rites.name: Soseollanum
rites.text: A passive craft that hardens the guard of heavily armored companions standing nearby. Their protection rises at the start of each turn and holds through their next actions.

rites.name: Coristus
rites.text: A trained technique that lets a wanderer cross rough ground as easily as open meadow, though sheer cliffs and deep waters still bar the way. Practitioners of a certain roguish craft learn it once they reach a middling level of mastery.

rites.name: Veostontium
rites.text: A passive discipline that a warrior can learn without inheriting it from a teacher. It steadies the body against incoming harm and is taught to the apprentice Zavrel.

rites.name: Vauntus
rites.text: A quiet, always-on craft that lets a practitioner draw on still, clear water. It can be acquired by one who learns it without inheritance, such as a fallen bearer of the old arts.

rites.name: Vontaunia
rites.text: A quiet, passive craft that a bearer can learn through practice rather than inheritance. Its user carries it at all times, and a single bearer may hold it by their own effort.

rites.name: Cernum
rites.text: A passive craft that quickens the bearer and nearby allies with each even-numbered turn. Warriors of the old guild can teach it to their apprentices.

rites.name: Nelosium
rites.text: A quiet inscribed mark carried by one wanderer that steadies the cold within them. It is bound to a single bearer and cannot be taken or shared.

rites.name: Nastus
rites.text: A passive guard that bolsters a fighter's protection against ranged strikes and spells from afar. Its highest form also cancels any bonuses the enemy has gained.

rites.name: Amaurnor
rites.text: A passive technique that hardens nearby mounted riders, raising their armor and ward against harm for their next moves. A veteran warden can teach it to a rider without any prior lineage.

rites.name: Seriarintia
rites.text: A deadly drifting haze that a warrior can learn to master without any teaching from a parent. It is first described in a battle-focused realm of heroes.

rites.name: Caloria
rites.text: A quiet passive gift that a pair of sisters, twin hunters of the frost, carry naturally without teaching. It belongs only to their line of warrior-craft.

rites.name: Corirneosum
rites.text: A passive craft that hardens a bearer's guard against blows and spells while a companion stands close beside them. Several wanderers may learn it, though one can only reach its lesser forms.

rites.name: Serialum
rites.text: A bearer's fighting force is swelled by a surge of ancestral heat, granting a hefty boost to strikes. It draws on a cheaper but more demanding reserve of inner energy than similar rites.

rites.name: Telaustes
rites.text: A combat discipline first taught through a wartime tale of shadowed valor. Practitioners strike with a blade whose wavy edge is said to rend armor.

rites.name: Cantanum
rites.text: A passive aerial technique that lets a winged fighter slip to any open square beside a nearby ally of the foot, horse, or armored sort. It works only for those who take to the sky and can be passed down to them.

rites.name: Rellor
rites.text: A soft exhale that drains the fight from an opponent's grip. It belongs to one wandering healer, marking her as a practitioner of gentle, calming arts.

rites.name: Rontilor
rites.text: A quiet passive craft that smothers the visible enhancements on foes who strike from afar during battle. Boosts granted mid-fight by rallying cries and surging draughts remain untouched.

rites.name: Sirnium
rites.text: A passive art of the guard that raises the defense of nearby companions, but only while few fellow travelers share the same manner of moving across the field.

rites.name: Oranteorum
rites.text: A passive craft that a few bound spirits and fiery beings can learn without inheriting it from another. Only two of them can reach its highest rung through their own study alone.

rites.name: Tastes
rites.text: A special technique practiced by a single bearer and a companion who shares it. It is held only by those two, passed on to no one else.

rites.name: Orenaustor
rites.text: A personal craft held by one wielder that strengthens their defense against most common foes. It fails against a set of specific caster and mounted types, and it has no effect on a few unusual foes.

rites.name: Sallaurnes
rites.text: A coordinated strike technique that a wielder can unleash only while bearing a particular sacred band of gold. It lets allies bring down fortifications and barriers with a single linked blow.

rites.name: Teliales
rites.text: A quiet, lasting knack that a fighter may learn without inheriting it from a teacher, granted by a pair of harvest-folk siblings. It is a passive gift that works on its own.

rites.name: Rosus
rites.text: A passive craft that swells the strength of its bearer and nearby allies at every second turn of a contest. Certain masters can learn it directly, without passing it down from a teacher.

rites.name: Vollantus
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that a wary warrior can learn without formal instruction. It narrows the gap between a fighter's guard and their resolve.

rites.name: Sontiasum
rites.text: A quiet, lasting craft of thorough recording that belongs to a single guardian of the gate. It is a passive gift, held by that one keeper alone and by no one else.

rites.name: Marum
rites.text: A combat technique practiced by warriors who gather their strength into a single forceful blow. It is one of the disciplined fighting methods taught within the lands of this world.

rites.name: Valaror
rites.text: A quiet passive knack that lets a wounded wanderer blink to the side of any companion once their strength has dwindled below a set threshold.

rites.name: Ceonor
rites.text: A passive craft that a wandering archer can learn on their own, without it being handed down. It lets the bearer's blade answer strikes made from far off.

rites.name: Corolum
rites.text: A specialized strike technique that only one particular heroic wanderer is able to perform. It is recorded as a special combat art unique to that single individual.

rites.name: Vialeontes
rites.text: A bound craft that, once a fighter opens a clash, pulls the opposing foe across the field to stand where the attacker stands. Several wanderers can learn it on their own without inheriting it.

rites.name: Tastaurium
rites.text: A passive discipline that a bearer can gain without any teacher, held by a legendary figure. It gives steady endurance against harm, shared among those who master it.

rites.name: Amaulium
rites.text: A fighting technique that unleashes a wide arc of flame across a battlefield. It is practiced as a martial craft by warriors who wield blades in combat.

rites.name: Launtium
rites.text: A passive art of rhythmic movement that strengthens the strikes and endurance of any companion revived by the performer's flowing steps. It is taught to one dancer without needing to be inherited from another.

rites.name: Teleranum
rites.text: A paired technique that a bearer can call upon when wearing a specific ring. Two allies lend their strength together in a shared, coordinated effort.

rites.name: Valases
rites.text: A hidden innate talent that a warrior unlocks after mastering the aerial rider calling. It is granted only to certain individuals who have trained long enough in that flying craft.

rites.name: Amillia
rites.text: A shadowy craft that a practitioner can learn and refine. It first appeared in a recent tale of warring houses and battle.

rites.name: Tausolor
rites.text: A passive craft that stirs a bearer's full strength in four rising grades. Each grade raises every core ability, yet the bearer is also hurt after each clash.

rites.name: Coroses
rites.text: A deadly reaping technique first recorded in a clash of three hopes, it shares a kinship with the art of ending lives swiftly.

rites.name: Tintanium
rites.text: A learned craft that lets its practitioners draw cold and stillness into their own strikes. It appears as a trained technique among those who study it.

rites.name: Serialus
rites.text: A combat discipline in which a fighter hurls a sudden burst of blazing projectiles across a field. It is practiced as a technique passed between warriors of a distant order.

rites.name: Telanor Losium
rites.text: A passive craft that a single wielder of the Corvane line carries, granting extra strikes to follow an opening blow. It is bound to one warrior alone.

rites.name: Niraunia
rites.text: A passive art that lets winged companions within two strides of the bearer glide to any spot beside them. Only those who take wing can inherit it.

rites.name: Vosentanum
rites.text: A chilling technique reserved for a single wielder, it allows a fighter to reflect cold-bound force back at an opponent. It belongs to one particular bearer and cannot be taught to others.

rites.name: Amirnes
rites.text: A ranked craft practiced by one wanderer who gains access to it partway through their journey. In a later battle-focused version it serves as a top-tier calling, paired with a second calling belonging only to that same wanderer.

rites.name: Tentia
rites.text: A passive craft that hardens the defenses of allied scaled beasts standing beside the bearer. At each turn's start, nearby kin gain added armor against blows and against spells.

rites.name: Tinernium
rites.text: A learned discipline granted by a bound instruction tome that raises every core attribute of its bearer by two. It cannot be inherited by offspring, yet anyone who obtains the tome may master it.

rites.name: Vestia
rites.text: A dormant inner power that a wanderer can awaken to lend aid to their companions in battle. Those who call upon it gain a grim, smoldering strength in the heat of conflict.

rites.name: Nornistum
rites.text: A passive discipline that sharpens a fighter's evasion once their strength drops low. Only those who have fully mastered a certain mounted aerial art may learn it.

rites.name: Seollus
rites.text: A quiet, passive discipline that a gifted pair of twin scholars can learn on their own, without needing it passed down. It steadies the wielder against blows.

rites.name: Cornelles
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack that a single wandering traveler learns on her own, without any teacher passing it down. It is a lesser, steady talent that aids the one who carries it.

rites.name: Oresium
rites.text: A passive technique that lets winged fighters in close combat strike with a plunging descent. Only certain warriors can learn it on their own, and others may receive it from them if they fight on foot in the air.

rites.name: Niasum Valastium
rites.text: A paired technique in which two bearers conjure matching sheets of frozen glass that reflect and sharpen one another's strikes. It was first shared by a duo who wielded it together.

rites.name: Ameollanum Valasium
rites.text: A passive craft that only creatures of breath can pass down to their kin. A certain keeper of the old ways can also learn it without any inheritance.

rites.name: Vistum
rites.text: A passive craft that hardens a bearer against blows and against spells, growing stronger with each level of mastery. Some can learn it without inheriting it from a teacher.

rites.name: Seronestum
rites.text: A sudden, unpredictable surge of celestial favor that a chosen figure may call upon in battle. It lets that figure act with a burst of unusual power.

rites.name: Costales
rites.text: A quiet inward discipline that a single wanderer has honed to a personal art. It grants the practitioner a steadier mind and a sharper awareness during moments of reflection.

rites.name: Lostium
rites.text: A passive discipline that toughens a bearer against inward harm. It is practiced as a steady, unbroken habit rather than a single act.

rites.name: Sintor
rites.text: A passive craft that lets a bearer grow sturdier and swifter in body. Its lesser form adds a little, and its stronger form adds more, though no further tier exists beyond it.

rites.name: Mollenium
rites.text: A defensive bearing that a warrior adopts to brace against incoming blows. It works much like a paired shield-guard drill taught in an earlier training tradition.

rites.name: Telaurnalia
rites.text: A craft granted by wearing a bond-ring forged from a deep friendship. Its wielder gains a rumbling, storm-like power drawn from the bond.

rites.name: Vaulum
rites.text: A quiet passive craft that sharpens the strikes and swiftness of creatures standing beside its bearer. Two wanderers can learn it without any lineage to pass it along.

rites.name: Teorniarium
rites.text: A quiet inner gift carried by a single warrior, lending steady resilience in battle. It belongs to one champion alone and is passed on to no other.

rites.name: Liantaulum
rites.text: A quiet, passive technique that a lone foot soldier can learn without teaching. Its bearer can pass it on to those who have trained them in the old craft of the wardens.

rites.name: Amaunornia
rites.text: A bonded fighter draws on a shared pact to endure harm longer. It can only be invoked by a warrior who wears a particular youthful band of silver.

rites.name: Ceolia
rites.text: A combat discipline that a warrior can draw upon to lift the spirits of allies on the battlefield. It first appears among the arts taught in a recent warfare manual.

rites.name: Taunium
rites.text: A rare inventive knack that a wielder can call upon in battle. It was first gained through a traveling sage who passed it along to a single bearer.

rites.name: Ameonores
rites.text: A trained discipline that steadies foot soldiers standing close by, hardening their guard and their resolve. Each blow they absorb while holding ground charges their signature technique a little faster.

rites.name: Orialles
rites.text: A tactical craft that a commander uses to turn the fortunes of an army. It first appeared in a war chronicle of a later era.

rites.name: Cestor
rites.text: A passive craft that lifts the strength of its wielder and every companion standing beside them by five for their next strike, renewed at the start of each turn.

rites.name: Raustellum
rites.text: A learned discipline of martial insight that a soldier develops, first shown in a later warfare tale. It grants the practitioner sharper judgment in battle.

rites.name: Seornium
rites.text: A hidden method lets a traveling companion be copied within a party, leaving a second identical member at the back of the roster. It requires a precise sequence of actions involving a fallen ally and a special revival relic.

rites.name: Tarniarium
rites.text: A craft in which a wielder releases a gathering radiance before striking, scorching every foe near the chosen target. The harm equals the wielder's force minus the enemy's guard.

rites.name: Telestaunes
rites.text: A passive craft that can be learned by a select few warriors without inheritance. Only foot soldiers are able to pass it on to others.

rites.name: Corestallia
rites.text: A practiced craft in which a fighter releases a building burst of force just before engaging, striking every foe clustered near the chosen opponent. Each struck foe takes harm equal to the fighter's strength minus the foe's armor or ward.

rites.name: Corintalia
rites.text: A passive art that lets a fighter drive an opponent backward one step once the clash is over, but only when the fighter begins the strike.

rites.name: Sestilum
rites.text: A learned skill that lets a practitioner grow more capable with particular handheld tools after long use. It first appeared in a recent battle-focused tale of rival lords.

rites.name: Seriallium
rites.text: A risky art of staking fortune on uncertain outcomes, first recorded in a wartime chronicle. Practitioners wager on chance to turn the tide of their endeavors.

rites.name: Rilleoranum
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets certain wardens steady their guard, and a finer grade of it can be handed down to aerial blade, spear, and axe fighters. Only a few named masters possess it outright.

rites.name: Coriarium Losernia
rites.text: A practiced stance lets a fighter take the blow aimed at a nearby companion, provided the two trust each other well enough. Guardian spirits often shield their summoner by drawing harm away from him.

rites.name: Serauntum
rites.text: A hidden measure carried by certain wanderers that quietly strengthens the blows they land during a second strike in quick succession. It is recorded in the ledgers of the old fighting halls.

rites.name: Orosteontia
rites.text: A quiet, lasting knack that a pair of linked bearers hold together and that no one else can take up. It works without being called upon and steadies whoever carries it.

rites.name: Valantus
rites.text: A learned discipline that renders a bearer nearly immune to harm. It was first recorded in a recent trial of warriors across the realm.

rites.name: Amirium Nentilia
rites.text: A passive craft that lends swiftness and striking force to winged companions stationed close by during battle. It is taught to a rider who has not inherited it from kin.

rites.name: Veonanum
rites.text: A signature technique wielded by a single bold fighter in a war-torn realm. It is a special combat action that cuts through tangled defenses with a decisive, unique strike.

rites.name: Tilor
rites.text: A combat discipline in which a fighter conceals their own presence from enemies. It is practiced as a trained art among warriors.

rites.name: Seronesum
rites.text: A coiled craft that a fighter readies before clashing with an opponent, releasing a rolling burst that strikes every enemy near the chosen target. Each blow's force equals the wielder's strength minus the foe's guard.

rites.name: Resania
rites.text: A helper's rallying command that flips every debuff laid upon an ally into a boost. Certain reversal curses are left untouched and keep working as before.

rites.name: Orastellum
rites.text: A giving craft held as a personal gift of one particular bearer. It flows from a single named person and belongs to them alone.

rites.name: Larnes
rites.text: A quiet inherited gift carried by a single bearer, unlocked only in one lineage. It is a passive trait that works without being called upon.

rites.name: Telanornium
rites.text: A passive craft granted to one legendary bearer alone. It is a second-tier technique that shapes how its holder fights in battle.

rites.name: Viallium
rites.text: A hardened armored form that only one ruling figure can take on during the final stand of a long conquest path. It is a single battle-state tied to a fierce commander.

rites.name: Oraunialum
rites.text: A minor passive craft that lifts allies who stand beside winged fighters, sharpening their strikes and quickening their movement. Several gifted riders can learn it without passing it down from a mentor.

rites.name: Telirnases
rites.text: A passive craft that lets foot soldiers nearby share a swift sword technique. Fighters who move quicker than their foes recharge their special moves sooner.

rites.name: Coristium
rites.text: A passive craft that belongs only to one dark figure, binding a lasting fate to them alone. It is a quiet, permanent trait tied to that single being.

rites.name: Mosum
rites.text: A quiet passive craft that lets a surviving caster's allies gather more charge from each clash. It can be taught to certain gifted users without any inheritance.

rites.name: Sanus
rites.text: A passive craft carried by one lone wanderer, weighing down every foe nearby with a lingering burden of sorrow. It belongs only to that single bearer and cannot be taught to others.

rites.name: Valernes
rites.text: A practiced art that lets a wielder take on the exact likeness of a chosen companion for a short span. Only a bearer's form changes, while gear and learned crafts stay behind.

rites.name: Telanium
rites.text: A aerial maneuver that a wielder may invoke while bound to a particular ancestral guardian spirit. It lets them lift off and drift across the battlefield.

rites.name: Orausenanum
rites.text: A sealed ward technique reserved for foes, which nullifies every blow aimed at the one who wields it. Several commanders in a late campaign book rely on it during key battles.

rites.name: Mialles
rites.text: A bound craft in which a wielder holds back a radiant force, keeping its brilliance from overwhelming the one who channels it. Only a single ascended bearer is known to command it.

rites.name: Vosaulor
rites.text: A quiet craft shared between two bearers who link their bond. It is unlocked when one of them wears a particular dawn-linked ring.

rites.name: Cianesanum
rites.text: A fighting discipline in which the practitioner channels radiant energy into a blade to strike foes. It is a combat technique taught among warriors.

rites.name: Teliarnorum
rites.text: A leader's trained technique that scatters an enemy host into disorder. It is wielded by commanders who rely on it to break formations before the main clash begins.

rites.name: Valarnialum
rites.text: A passive craft that a single named wanderer possesses and that belongs only to them. It is classed among the lesser, everyday arts practiced by those who serve in bands of friends.

rites.name: Nornium
rites.text: A guiding bond that lets one trained companion pass on learned craft to a bearer who wears a special teaching band. It can be called upon only while that band is worn.

rites.name: Verneorium
rites.text: A trained support technique in which a fighter standing beside an ally sharpens that ally's quickness and guard until the current round ends. It can be learned by a practitioner without passing it down from a teacher.

rites.name: Veosauntor
rites.text: A soothing aid technique that grants a gentle restful blessing to a companion in battle. It is a refined form of an older, milder restorative practice, practiced only by one specific attuned bearer.

rites.name: Raustia
rites.text: A personal fighting style for one wandering duelist, who strikes with a blade and can also perform a graceful dance. It closely mirrors an older dancing discipline in everything but its appearance.

rites.name: Vasus
rites.text: A quiet, always-active discipline that a single famed commander of the Ember Court alone is able to master. It grants a constant, lasting edge to anyone who practices it.

rites.name: Marialles
rites.text: A battle technique that lets a fighter trade places with a nearby ally in the middle of combat. It appears as a learned maneuver that different schools of warriors can master.

rites.name: Valenaures
rites.text: A passive craft that lets its practitioner move with quickened footing. It is a standing discipline of the lighter-armed, taught as a basic form of training.

rites.name: Coralum Riasia
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a practitioner stir fortune in their favor during contests of skill. It first appeared in a recent field of study among warriors.

rites.name: Telantor Tenauntes
rites.text: A personal talent held by one teacher-figure in a scholarly academy, passed to a single student. It belongs to the one who bears it alone.

rites.name: Cillus
rites.text: A supportive craft in which one fighter quickens and hardens a nearby companion for the remainder of a round. The bonus fades once that round concludes.

rites.name: Costes
rites.text: A quiet, lasting binding that a single bearer carries as a passive gift. It is held only by one particular warrior and cannot be taken up by anyone else.

rites.name: Lisor
rites.text: A raider's fighting craft in which the wielder strikes hard with a heavy blade-head on a haft. Practitioners are found across many lands and are known for close, brutal melee.

rites.name: Leostaranum
rites.text: A learned skill that lets a fighter shrug off hostile magic. It was first recorded in a tale of shadowed lands.

rites.name: Nauseria
rites.text: A shared gift carried by one pair of companions alone. It was first granted in a later age of wandering heroes, and no other bond can awaken it.

rites.name: Ciranum
rites.text: A linked technique that a bearer can call upon while wearing a particular ornamental band of a solitary heir. It lets the bearer gain strength quickly.

rites.name: Laurnus Lares
rites.text: A calling that marks one particular figure, shaping the path they walk. It belongs solely to a single heir who carries it.

rites.name: Leonasor
rites.text: A tactical technique where a warrior's ally is granted a quick strike drawn from a stormy burst of energy. It first appeared in a recent battle-training manual.

rites.name: Tenornia
rites.text: A stealthy combat and utility discipline practiced by fighters who move unseen. Its adherents strike swiftly and aid their allies through clever, quiet tactics.

rites.name: Nornia Meranum
rites.text: A steadfast passive craft that anchors its bearer so they cannot easily be moved or knocked from their footing. It can be taught to a student who never received it by inheritance.

rites.name: Teleontinor
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a fighter act with sudden speed after a moment of stillness. It first appeared in a recent martial tradition of the realm.

rites.name: Orintallum
rites.text: A passive craft that lets its bearer bar foes from crossing the spaces beside them. Several wanderers and tutors can learn it without any inherited lineage.

rites.name: Tauntiania
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a fighter draw a foe's attention and anger, pulling enemies into reckless moves. It is taught and practiced among warriors in the wider world.

rites.name: Cilosia Tollor
rites.text: A quiet inherited knack that lifts a bearer's gliding reach whenever a kindred spirit's song rings out. It is a sibling-technique that echoes the craft of a particular attuned wayfarer.

rites.name: Seraustia
rites.text: A clever trading skill belonging to one particular traveling merchant-heroine, letting her support allies with sharp dealings. It serves as her own special aid in battle.

rites.name: Valeonelum
rites.text: A dormant ember-craft that stirs within a single bearer, lending a quiet, persistent hazard to their presence. It answers only to one specific wielder and cannot be shared.

rites.name: Valiares Caurostium
rites.text: A passive gift of the second tier that belongs to a single named warrior alone. It is a skill carried in the heart of one bearer and cannot be passed to another.

rites.name: Valentilus
rites.text: A practice of sun-timed vitality in which a bearer mends a portion of the harm they inflict upon others during the midday hours. It is a gift drawn from the heat of the high sun.

rites.name: Corauntanum
rites.text: A dark incantation that conjures green ooze around a chosen foe, which then bursts and wounds them. Its caster can strike distant enemies safely, even those who might otherwise return fire.

rites.name: Valiriasus
rites.text: A special technique exclusive to one legendary warrior that cancels the effect of a certain kind of attack. It counts as a unique skill of its type.

rites.name: Ceosor
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a leader lift the spirits and strength of nearby allies. It first appeared in a wartime tale of rival houses.

rites.name: Seriantia Saurus
rites.text: A passive art that may only be passed down to heavily plated fighters. It belongs to the second tier of learned techniques and lets such warriors follow up their strikes in a distinctive way.

rites.name: Sillum Lausanium
rites.text: A bond of fragile living force that a caretaker can call upon to aid an ally in battle. It is a skill passed through one specific guardian, granted as a single support technique.

rites.name: Amaurium
rites.text: A learned craft of drawing bright, searing light from within the body. Practitioners channel it to strike at distant foes with a glowing, piercing force.

rites.name: Reollus
rites.text: A practiced craft lets a user step instantly to any open ground they can see on the field, sparing the walk. In some traditions it instead lets them appear beside a companion or a foe, then act again.

rites.name: Ceontollium
rites.text: A passive discipline that cancels the forced pursuit strikes others can impose on its bearer, and nullifies the guard that stops foes from pursuing. Only foot soldiers can pass it down to their heirs.

rites.name: Rarnontium
rites.text: A coined craft that quietly boosts a bearer's brute force and nimble precision by a set measure. It is one of the gifts a person can carry as a learned knack.

rites.name: Venia
rites.text: A fighting technique that a warrior practices alone, first recorded in a training manual of a distant guild. It lets the practitioner hold their ground against many foes at once.

rites.name: Lenium
rites.text: A passive craft that hardens a fighter the moment a clash begins, boosting their strength and guard while stopping a foe from striking again in reply.

rites.name: Seosentium
rites.text: A rare inner spark that grants a fighter a small chance to take a second turn after acting. Each spark adds a few percent, and enemy champions can also carry it, making their double strikes perilous.

rites.name: Mauntus
rites.text: A passive craft that lets a bearer who is normally vulnerable to heavy plating take ordinary harm from armor-piercing strikes. Only one particular artisan of the order can teach it to others.

rites.name: Veollia
rites.text: A fighting discipline in which a warrior channels every ounce of strength into a single desperate blow. It is taught as a technique of combat.

rites.name: Villarium
rites.text: A learned craft that is awakened when a bearer wears a bond-ring tied to a legendary ally. It lets the wearer share in a companion's gift.

rites.name: Viasenia
rites.text: A defensive craft that lets a bearer raise a protective ward to guard an ally. It was first recorded being taught to a young noble of the kingdom's court.

rites.name: Rolia
rites.text: A quiet, crimson-hued breath power that a fallen sorceress wields exclusively. It is drawn from the mind and channeled into a weapon without any spoken incantation.

rites.name: Cerus Valeosia
rites.text: A learned craft in which a caster gathers and releases a clouding mist that hinders nearby foes. It is taught to practitioners who wish to weaken enemies from within a shrouded field.

rites.name: Casanum
rites.text: A battle discipline taught to a single warrior, enabling a strike that never spares the foe. It can be learned directly rather than passed down from a teacher.

rites.name: Orosor Amesum
rites.text: A dormant technique that cancels the arcane energies of others when a practitioner has perfected certain shadowed disciplines. It surfaces rarely, granted only to those who master the darkest forms of their craft.

rites.name: Misanum
rites.text: A passive discipline that steadies its bearer and nearby allies, hardening their guard by a set measure on every other cycle. Certain trained wanderers can learn it without a formal teacher.

rites.name: Sereores
rites.text: A rolling gathering of force that a bearer can call upon while wearing a particular sacred band. It lets the wielder carry one's striking momentum from a shared bond into a single, unbroken advance.

rites.name: Vinteorum
rites.text: A tactical trick used by spellcasters to outmaneuver foes in battle. It first appeared in a recent warrior-style tale of many fronts.

rites.name: Laloria
rites.text: A tactical knack that lets a blade-wielder land more devastating blows when striking true. It can be granted by wearing a sacred band forged from a trusted companion's loyalty.

rites.name: Oreoranum
rites.text: A tactic in which a fighter laces an attack with toxin to weaken the foe. It appears as a newly introduced maneuver in a recent martial tradition.

rites.name: Amausium Sarnes
rites.text: A learned discipline that lets a fighter keep pressing forward through hardship. It first appeared in a recent martial training manual of the realm.

rites.name: Tellor
rites.text: An unofficial grouping of special battle techniques that a fighter can use to strike harder when seizing a position. The name is only a guess made by commentators rather than one given by the makers.

rites.name: Valeosanum
rites.text: A bond-craft that lets a bearer draw on the strength of a chosen ally once they wear a particular bangle of shared heritage. The craft works only while that token is worn.

rites.name: Amastornes
rites.text: A specialized fighting discipline reserved for a single named practitioner, marked by precise long-range striking. It belongs solely to one individual and defines their combat role.

rites.name: Amialornium
rites.text: A passive craft that slows the movement of every rival within two paces of its wielder. It can be taught to a few practitioners without passing it down through their lineage.

rites.name: Amiasor
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a warrior pursues a retreating foe across the field, keeping pace and striking as the chase continues. It was taught in a later age of drilled combat.

rites.name: Siallia
rites.text: A passive craft that weakens the guard of every foe standing close by. Several warriors can learn it on their own, without passing it down from another.

rites.name: Velliantum
rites.text: A craft practiced only by two royal sisters who blend the skills of mounted riders and wing-keepers. It draws together the strengths of their paired disciplines into a single fighting style.

rites.name: Tauntium Amonialus
rites.text: A passive craft that saps the quickness and guard of every foe standing within two paces of the bearer. It can be taught to a warrior by a particular wanderer without being passed down through a lineage.

rites.name: Riarnus Telarneones
rites.text: A support role that moves allies swiftly across the battlefield. It first appeared in an early chronicle of the Ashen Realms.

rites.name: Teleornes
rites.text: A passive discipline that hardens the bearer against sudden assaults. It belongs to a class of quiet, always-on practices taught among wandering guild-artisans.

rites.name: Teleneostes
rites.text: A movement-aiding craft that lets a fighter steer their own destiny, shifting their position to support an ally in the field.

rites.name: Mauliror
rites.text: A cunning technique of the sly class that grants a chance to instantly drop ordinary foes outright. It stands as an alternate path to the lethal arts, sparing the leaders of armies from its effect.

rites.name: Tauntornium
rites.text: A tool-wielding technique that delivers a crushing strike. It belongs to the arsenal of martial skills taught to fighters in the land.

rites.name: Corernus
rites.text: A rare craft exclusive to elevated wardens of a shadowed guild, channeled to unleash a devastating surge of darkness. It can only be wielded by those who have reached the highest tier of training.

rites.name: Vellia Viasaunum
rites.text: A coordinated craft in which allied fighters link their efforts into a single combined maneuver. It is performed during battle among companions who stand together.

rites.name: Roliarnanum
rites.text: A specialized power unlocked only by mid-rank bearers of a particular shadowy lineage. It releases a sudden burst of dark flame that shakes the battlefield.

rites.name: Siallonanum
rites.text: A passive discipline held only by a fallen sovereign, it lets its bearer resist harm in a way others cannot learn. It belongs to one ruler alone.

rites.name: Leonor
rites.text: A learned fighting technique that lets a mounted or winged warrior crash through foes in their path. It is unlocked only by those who have fully mastered a flying-beast rider's craft.

rites.name: Mallus Coroneolium
rites.text: A passive craft that lowers the strength and guard of every foe standing near its bearer. When it takes hold, the bearer's own strength and guard rise in turn. Several figures can learn it without inheriting it.

rites.name: Mentum
rites.text: A mounted fighting technique shared by all beast riders of the ridge clans. It grants a steady boost to attack and, when a rider first strikes, drains the foe's strength and guard while blocking their counterattack.

rites.name: Leonium Nasianor
rites.text: A specialized calling that lies above a fearless brawler's path and is reached through promotion. It is classed as an advanced tier that a dread warrior may ascend into.

rites.name: Vistum Tilles
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a single wielder perceive a blade's inner nature. It belongs to one particular fighter alone.

rites.name: Corellor Sallium
rites.text: A soothing aid technique that lets a caster lift an ally's spirit with a flowing rhythm. It is a refined form of an older performance art, practiced only in one distant realm.

rites.name: Tialarnor
rites.text: A tempest-born skill that a single warrior can call upon in battle. It belongs to one fighter's personal repertoire and is unleashed as a unique action.

rites.name: Niasteror
rites.text: A passive discipline taught in a northern fortress-hall that lets a combatant keep guard against sudden attack. Several wandering champions in a distant tournament arena can learn it without inheriting it from another.

rites.name: Sellia
rites.text: A tactical craft that a fighter can call upon to turn a battle in their favor. It first appeared in a later chapter of an invented saga of war.

rites.name: Orisanum
rites.text: A quiet inherited knack that a tribe's hunters can pick up through practice rather than birthright. It lingers as a steady, unspoken art passed between two gatherers of the harvest.

rites.name: Tiseorium
rites.text: A refined restorative art of soft light that mends wounds and weariness. It is taught and practiced within the realm's scholarly circles.

rites.name: Voriallus
rites.text: A passive discipline that a fighter maintains without effort, letting them brace against incoming strikes at all times. It belongs to the family of quiet, always-active practices.

rites.name: Rolleostia
rites.text: A passive craft that grants a bearer added resistance in struggle whenever they hold a clear lead in vitality over their rival. It can be taught to a student without any inheritance from a predecessor.

rites.name: Liantanum
rites.text: A bold gust-borne tactic unique to one commander in a battle-hymn war. It lets the wielder hurl the storm forward and strike with the surging wind.

rites.name: Valesia Veonantum
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a combatant spins through a rotating strike that hits all foes nearby. It was recently taught to warriors who train at arms.

rites.name: Telausirnus
rites.text: A bold, sudden burst of reckless force that a single wielder can unleash in battle. It belongs to one fighter's personal repertoire of signature actions.

rites.name: Coresilus
rites.text: A blade or spear that gathers doubled practice whenever it finishes off a foe. Once it has felled enough enemies it begins to strike with sharper, more frequent precision.

rites.name: Meornaria
rites.text: A battle-weakening craft in which a commander's technique gradually reduces an opponent's fighting strength. It is taught as a skill passed down among leaders of armed companies.

rites.name: Valintanum
rites.text: A passive craft that a warrior gains through a particular companion, granting a mid-tier battle technique. It is found on a skill chart that is one of the mid-level options for the fighter.

rites.name: Tinteonor
rites.text: A fighting technique that a warrior can use to answer an incoming blow with a swift, timed riposte. It first appeared in a recent martial tale of three hopes.

rites.name: Tiarillium
rites.text: A passive craft that, during a clash, cancels the visible strength gains of foes who fight with short-reach arms. Temporary boosts granted mid-battle still take effect as usual.

rites.name: Ceosenes
rites.text: A learned craft that cancels the lift granted to winged beings, bringing a soaring foe back down to earth. It first appears in a tale of three rival households.

rites.name: Sirium
rites.text: A passive art that certain foot soldiers and winged fighters may pass down to others. It is a minor, inherited technique that only those on foot or in flight can learn.

rites.name: Teleontium
rites.text: A fighter launches skyward, then thrusts an extended limb into a huge spear. The spear pins whatever it strikes and can hold foes in place until the fighter kicks or leaps free.

rites.name: Teleria
rites.text: A quiet passive craft that steadies fighters standing close by during battle, shielding them from harm. Many gifted warriors can train in it without needing to inherit it from a teacher.

rites.name: Naliases
rites.text: A breath-art and combat technique that exists only within one tale of heroes and battles. It grants its wielder a special skill in the field of arms.

rites.name: Vianentes
rites.text: A tactical maneuver that a commander can perform in battle to unsettle the enemy. It is learned and used through the rules of a modern-era conflict.

rites.name: Nostanum
rites.text: A radiant craft that a practitioner can learn and wield in battle. It is recorded as having first appeared in a later tale of struggle and conquest.

rites.name: Maules Orauntes
rites.text: A passive discipline that, at the start of each round, hardens the guard of the allies who already stand strongest, sparing the one who practices it. Several wayfarers can learn it without formal teaching.

rites.name: Restium
rites.text: A passive discipline that strengthens a fighter during battle, growing stronger the more comrades stand within two steps. It can be taught to a learner without being passed down from a mentor.

rites.name: Amontum
rites.text: A quiet, lasting art of bracing oneself against harm before it arrives. Practitioners carry it as a steady inner ward that softens blows across every struggle.

rites.name: Tornisus
rites.text: Techniques that sit beside ordinary strikes in the arena, giving fighters extra methods they can call upon. They expand the ways a combatant can act in battle.

rites.name: Mirauses
rites.text: A sealed ward that lets a bearer shrug off every kind of harm completely. Only foes wielding it can call upon this protection in battle.

rites.name: Orauranum
rites.text: A passive craft that a bearer can learn without inheriting it. It can be taught by one particular kind of gentle healer, and it sharpens the bearer's guarding instincts in battle.

rites.name: Sostenanum
rites.text: A dancing craft that a single wandering performer carries as a personal gift. It draws out unusual, inquisitive movement from whoever learns it.

rites.name: Saulontor
rites.text: A passive art that a skilled bearer can learn without formal tutoring. It lets a practitioner move through the air with a gentle, steady current.

rites.name: Sesontanum
rites.text: A quiet passive knack that a new kind of bearer can carry, granted to one figure who first wore it. It belongs to a lighter, seasonal variety of its craft.

rites.name: Coralum
rites.text: A bonded aid technique that a specific legendary healer can perform for allies. It lends them a boost in the heat of battle.

rites.name: Sauntenor
rites.text: A passive discipline that a warrior can learn without inheriting it from another. It is taught by a single named practitioner, and its exact effect is left unspecified.

rites.name: Sares
rites.text: A shadowed technique that lets a fighter call on a hidden ally's help during combat. It first appeared in a battle-focused tale of three paths.

rites.name: Valestia
