rites.text: A passive craft that hardens a fighter when no companion stands beside them. The lone warrior gains greater guard against blows and spells during battle, and the strongest form of this craft is taught only to one particular master.

rites.name: Telastus
rites.text: A quiet passive technique that a creature of the mists can learn without being taught by any lineage. It grants a steady, background advantage to those who master it.

rites.name: Valiantanum
rites.text: A bonding craft that lets two companions link their spirits while a special band of signet worn by one of them is in place. It is drawn from a shared love of a beloved dish.

rites.name: Tiaror
rites.text: A quiet, lasting discipline that can be taken up by a single practitioner without teaching. It is held by a particular winter-born scholar of the cold months.

rites.name: Coriallanum
rites.text: A quiet discipline that lets blade-wielders gather learning faster from each clash, so long as the wielder walks away from the fight standing.

rites.name: Silum
rites.text: A passive craft that lends swiftness to companions standing within two paces during a clash. It can be taught to many wielders without being passed down through a bloodline.

rites.name: Orollium
rites.text: A soothing assisting art that lets an ally refresh themselves in battle. It works like a sharper, later form of a traditional performance practiced by one particular people.

rites.name: Sianus
rites.text: A quiet, secondary talent that a warrior may learn on their own rather than receiving it from an ancestor. It belongs to a second tier of gifts, and certain bearers of a particular lineage can attain it without a family inheritance.

rites.name: Cesia
rites.text: A leader's trained talent that lets them hold their ground without fear. It is granted by the commander's skill set during combat.

rites.name: Corastanum
rites.text: A passive gift borne only by winged fighters from the common pool. It grants steady vitality, and once a fighter reaches the top rank and the fortieth level, it also sharpens how that fighter is judged in contest grounds.

rites.name: Valaunarum
rites.text: A forbidden breath-craft that a single wanderer alone is able to wield. It is channeled only during the closing trial of a shadowed tale.

rites.name: Lentanium
rites.text: A bond-craft that lets a wielder call upon the power of a joined ancient sovereign. It works only while the wielder is bound to that particular sovereign.

rites.name: Telenus
rites.text: A sealed technique that lets its wielder slip through the passage of hours, drawn from the sacred seal lore of a hero-gathering tale. It is passed among warriors who bind it into their gear.

rites.name: Amarnires
rites.text: A tactical martial technique wielded by commanders in a fantasy realm, allowing a leader to strike with sudden brilliance. It is taught and used among captains in the world's armies.

rites.name: Corausum
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a practitioner channel heat and flame through a single surge of combat power. It first appeared in a recent warrior-style tale of three rival paths.

rites.name: Rollaustia
rites.text: A passive art that a gentle keeper may learn without passing it down from another. It is taught to a single apprentice who carries it quietly through their work.

rites.name: Sariallia
rites.text: A passive skill of the sort that a particular mirrored warrior carries as a faint reflection of her own strength. It is called upon when a second bearer's legacy resonates across the field.

rites.name: Seores
rites.text: A quiet inherited talent that a lone wanderer can gain without training for it. It lets the bearer draw on the warmth stored in the ground beneath them.

rites.name: Amires
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that a wanderer can master without teaching. It is carried as a steady, unspoken habit rather than a visible gift.

rites.name: Centanum
rites.text: A quiet inner craft that steadies the bearer and nearby allies against hostile forces. Its warding strengthens on every second turn of a campaign, and a few gifted wanderers can learn it without a teacher.

rites.name: Nenium Rantium
rites.text: A learned technique of fierce inner momentum, first set down in a recent war-chronicle of a single campaign. It lets a fighter press onward through strain and drive their allies forward in the same stroke.

rites.name: Varestum
rites.text: A combat discipline that first appears in a recent martial tradition, where practitioners strike with rapid, dazzling blows.

rites.name: Ceontor
rites.text: A quiet passive technique that a wandering duelist can learn on her own, without it being handed down. It answers the strikes of rivals in a reflected, sharpened way.

rites.name: Tollases
rites.text: A tactical discipline that lowers the strength of foes in battle. It is taught as a leader's technique and is set into a commander's repertoire of skills.

rites.name: Leorelus
rites.text: A calculating captain's technique that works out how much harm a blow will deal. It is granted to fighters through the ranks of a hero-gathering contest.

rites.name: Tesorum
rites.text: A winged-beast strike technique that lets airborne creatures move one step farther and strike two points harder. It belongs to every flying beast and mirrors a common family of blades and tomes.

rites.name: Tasteonor
rites.text: A combat technique that lets a warrior unleash a savage, ferocious strength in battle. It is passed along by a legendary creature called a stag-king.

rites.name: Lernia
rites.text: A passive discipline held by a single bearer, tied to a legendary figure of the realm. It is granted only to that one individual and cannot be learned by others.

rites.name: Coriallus
rites.text: A passive mounted discipline that grants a riders steady vitality, and when a veteran rider reaches full mastery it sharpens how their worth is judged in contest arenas.

rites.name: Valeranum
rites.text: A healing craft in which a caregiver's restorative touch with a staff briefly hardens every companion nearby, lifting their strength and resilience for one turn. Only a few trained tenders master it without passing it down from a teacher.

rites.name: Lialauntium
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that a wandering champion can learn without being taught by a mentor. It steadies the mind against harmful forces.

rites.name: Oriallus
rites.text: A passive discipline of quiet endurance that a warrior can learn without being taught it by a mentor. It grants steady protection against harm while the bearer stands near a sanctuary.

rites.name: Corarium
rites.text: A passive technique that a warrior can learn without inheriting it from another. It is taught to a particular wanderer during a festival of new beginnings.

rites.name: Montiaror
rites.text: A ruinous strike unleashed only by a single foe, a heavy force that hits everything with crushing power. Its weight can grow when certain circumstances line up.

rites.name: Amaunus
rites.text: A passive art that a fighter can learn without being taught by a master, granted to a single wandering swordsman who trained alone.

rites.name: Canum
rites.text: A passive craft that raises the guard of its bearer and of allies standing beside them every other alternate turn. Several warriors can learn it on their own without passing it down through a lineage.

rites.name: Sirnia
rites.text: A passive technique that lets a warrior strengthen the strikes of companions standing within two steps. It is taught to a select few fighters who can pass it on through battle.

rites.name: Orirastium
rites.text: A passive art that a fighter can learn without inheriting it from a teacher. A certain elder warrior is able to pass it on to others.

rites.name: Telernum
rites.text: A bonded technique that can be drawn upon while joined to a specific ancient bearer. It lets the wielder call on a lingering resonance within the partnership.

rites.name: Rornium
rites.text: A passive craft that can be learned without inheritance by a wandering seer. It is a minor attunement that grants its bearer a lesser, quieter form of strength in battle.

rites.name: Nasus
rites.text: A quiet inner trust that a passive gift of the chosen bearer grants, and that only one particular wedded pair of royal kin can carry. It rests on steady belief in the goodness of common people.

rites.name: Valosia
rites.text: A quiet inner resolve that stirs a fighter's strength at the start of each round whenever their life force burns low. Several seasoned warriors can learn it on their own, without inheriting it from a mentor.

rites.name: Verum
rites.text: A passive craft that lets a fighter who holds a small margin of vitality strike harder during a clash. It can be taught to certain warriors without being passed down through a bloodline.

rites.name: Ameontes
rites.text: A quiet inner talent that a pair of paired attendants can learn without formal tutelage. It is a passive technique of the second grade, granted to a single duo of companions.

rites.name: Nilases
rites.text: A quiet, lasting inner trait that a fighter can acquire without any teaching or inheritance. It is held in a sustained, unchanging form, passed through a single deliberate bond.

rites.name: Sinor
rites.text: A passive craft held by a single trickster figure of an invented pantheon, shaping how that being moves through contests. It is kept by one wandering schemer alone.

rites.name: Maustium
rites.text: A quiet, steady discipline that lets a fighter keep a rhythm of readiness in their stance. It is practiced as a lasting passive habit rather than a single strike.

rites.name: Valaurnanum
rites.text: A learned technique that strengthens a bearer's guard against blows. It is practiced as a skill in the wider world.

rites.name: Tintium
rites.text: A passive craft granted to one singular commander that lets a warrior endure blows with steadfast protective strength. Only a single ruler may hold this discipline.

rites.name: Taullentor
rites.text: A passive shielding craft that lets nearby companions brace against foes striking from afar. Allies within two steps gain added guard and steadiness when struck by archers, casters, and thrown-blade wielders.

rites.name: Visaules
rites.text: A paired performance technique where two skilled performers combine their gifts into one dazzling strike. Its triggering lets everyone in the gathering act once more, lengthening the show.

rites.name: Ceolloranum
rites.text: A passive craft that a fighter carries into battle, quietly bolstering defense against harm. It was first taught alongside a harvest-time ritual.

rites.name: Mantisor
rites.text: A passive craft held only by one attuned seer, quietly shaping how that individual binds to allies. It is a minor, supporting gift rather than a dominant power.

rites.name: Nausontus
rites.text: A quiet, lasting gift that a young wanderer can learn without a teacher's passing down. It answers distant harm with a rebound that returns to the one who struck.

rites.name: Veoliastum
rites.text: A special command that a war leader can use during chapters with allied fighters, letting the leader guide how the computer-controlled allies act. It works in a similar way to a formal order.

rites.name: Sistonanum
rites.text: A layered defensive craft that a skilled user can learn in several stages. It is tied to a particular later-era art of combat and shelters its wielder against harm.

rites.name: Coriasus
rites.text: A trained evasive technique that grants a fixed boost to a fighter's ability to slip past incoming blows. It is taught as a skill within the practice of combat.

rites.name: Viarneonium
rites.text: A passive art that is held quietly by a warrior. At the start of each round it weakens the guard of nearby enemies who have less resistance than the user.

rites.name: Nalleostium
rites.text: A quiet inherited gift that lies dormant in a bearer until a reckoning awakens its steady, supporting power. It belongs to the ordinary arts of battle and is passed among those who train with blade and bow.

rites.name: Orosialia
rites.text: A passive craft that a sea-spirit can learn on its own without inheriting it. It belongs to the Heroes-style tradition of fighting arts.

rites.name: Coreollia
rites.text: A passive discipline that a warrior can gain without training for it, shared through a bond with a bride-like companion. It belongs to a second tier of learned techniques.

rites.name: Lausor
rites.text: A passive art that quietly weakens the guard of foes standing near a performer who dances or sings. It is taught directly to a single gifted dancer without needing to be passed down from another.

rites.name: Serestum
rites.text: A spontaneous improvised technique that a performer unleashes in the middle of a show. It works as a sudden burst of power that strikes an opponent.

rites.name: Sistalanum
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a fighter move freely while wearing heavy plate. It was devised in a recent age of mass-forged arms and sits among the minor techniques of the craft.

rites.name: Valeolum
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter delivers a brutal, enhanced blow. It was first recorded in a modern warrior training tradition.

rites.name: Rantus
rites.text: A devastating technique that delivers a crushing strike, first appearing in a modern strategy tale. It batters foes with force enough to stagger them.

rites.name: Ameornostia
rites.text: A singular combat technique belonging to one warrior in a war-torn realm. It is used as that fighter's signature power in battle.

rites.name: Telirnium Manintor
rites.text: A quiet, unforced technique that a wandering tinker can pick up on their own, without needing it passed down from a teacher. It sits among the second tier of ingrained habits practiced in the guild halls.

rites.name: Valinaules
rites.text: A quiet, innate knack that lets a fighter answer a blow at once when sudden danger draws close. It can be taught to a student who has not inherited it from their line.

rites.name: Siallus
rites.text: A tactical maneuver in which a warrior unleashes a rapid, sustained barrage of blows to overwhelm an opponent. It first appears in the chronicles of the Three Realms.

rites.name: Sereonterum
rites.text: A quiet, lasting technique that a single wandering tinkerer can learn without any teacher, granting steadier guard against harm. It belongs to the craft of the tinkerer's own artificer guild.

rites.name: Contaunia
rites.text: A passive craft that lets a wielder of a rod-shaped instrument silence a foe's retaliation the moment the wielder strikes. Several named practitioners can learn it without prior training.

rites.name: Amaulles
rites.text: A tactical craft that lets a fighter call on a comrade's flames to aid an attack. It was introduced in a recent martial tale of three rival houses.

rites.name: Corialus
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter answers an incoming strike with a swift retaliatory blow. It first appeared in a modern warrior-themed tale of battle and alliance.

rites.name: Centialium
rites.text: A battle-leader's craft that stirs allies into a brighter fighting fervor. It is granted by a commander and sharpens the strength of those who fight beside them.

rites.name: Neosialor
rites.text: A passive gift that a fighter carries from the moment a battle begins. It arrives alongside a pair of frost-touched companions and aids the bearer quietly.

rites.name: Serialeosum
rites.text: A spontaneous surge of arcane power that a single wielder can call upon to support allies. It arises from the wielder's own bond with the fighting force around them.

rites.name: Telantes
rites.text: A bold battle ability belonging to a single warrior, unlocked as that fighter's signature power. It lets the wielder perform a rousing, fearless action during combat.

rites.name: Sereonialus
rites.text: A personal mid-rank calling that one wanderer unlocks once the opening chapter of their journey concludes. It marks a new stage of skill for that single individual alone.

rites.name: Vosus
rites.text: A learned technique that lets a fighter break through a rival's defensive challenge in a battle-tested training hall. It first appeared in a recent book of combat arts.

rites.name: Liaraulum
rites.text: A minor passive technique that lets a performer strengthen the guard of a companion they revive through a rhythmic art. It belongs only to one tabletop-style digital contest realm.

rites.name: Seresia
rites.text: A coordinated stratagem that a band of allies performs together during a clash. Its frozen-themed execution is first seen in a recent campaign of the realm.

rites.name: Vauntestium
rites.text: A quiet inner gift carried by a single hero, which works without being activated and grants a steady advantage to its bearer alone.

rites.name: Orastia
rites.text: A passive craft that cannot be broken through, held by a single legendary champion. It shields its bearer against all incoming harm.

rites.name: Amonanum
rites.text: A learned discipline that lets a wielder strike with a blade-thrown precision. It is a trained technique tied to the small, sharp weapons that a skilled hand can aim.

rites.name: Nonium
rites.text: A bonded technique that a wearer can invoke once they have fastened a particular twin-stoned band. It lets the bearer draw on a shared resonance with a partner.

rites.name: Ceoranum
rites.text: A learned bodily knack that lets a fighter slip past incoming spear strikes more easily. It was first recorded in a tale of three rival courts.

rites.name: Teleosantia
rites.text: A passive craft that lets a wielder steady their body against forced displacement. It can be handed down from one practitioner to another through training.

rites.name: Ternes
rites.text: A bright support technique that lets a chosen companion take an extra turn action. It also lets airborne or foot-bound allies move one additional step, and only one singer in the realm can perform it.

rites.name: Cialles
rites.text: A passive craft in two tiers that moderately strengthens a wielder's vitality and resilience. The higher tier grants a greater measure of this bolstering, and a few specific individuals may learn it without prior training.

rites.name: Oraulium Losteosanum
rites.text: A tactical maneuver used in a modern conflict setting. It is first introduced in a single recent campaign and is employed by several allied units together.

rites.name: Corastum
rites.text: A binding state that severs a bearer from all aid, so that no helping craft can be drawn upon or aimed at them. It can be laid on by a certain ritual wheel or a particular bridge rite.

rites.name: Vantesus
rites.text: A rare inborn talent that lets a warrior react with uncanny speed, and it can be gained without passing it down from an ancestor. A certain archer carries it naturally.

rites.name: Nirnor
rites.text: A downloadable technique that a fighter can unlock to push past their normal bounds. It is available only through an add-on purchase, so not every warrior can learn it.

rites.name: Merium
rites.text: A quiet inner gift that a single crafted tutor can pass to a student without any ancestral line. It is a minor passive talent that sharpens a bearer's natural spark.

rites.name: Sentaurnor
rites.text: A rare power wielded by a small circle of gifted figures, each able to send a pulse rippling outward through nearby ground and air. One pulse can muffle the voices of those nearby, while others inflict harm on everyone within a wide ring.

rites.name: Carnintia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that a bearer of the sky-blood gains through a loyal companion. It is taught to a fighter who has just come into the field for the first time.

rites.name: Reolleria
rites.text: A passive gift of soaring feathers that a single chosen wanderer carries from the moment of its arrival. It is bound to one figure alone and cannot be shared with others.

rites.name: Maustia
rites.text: A soothing aid technique that grants a fighter a sleep-touched boon in the midst of battle. It is a refined form of an older night-terror craft, kept only by one attuned seer.

rites.name: Teones
rites.text: A dazzling technique that can be taught to a warrior who never inherited it, and it is passed on by a single figure trained in the art of arms.

rites.name: Sanium Valasiarium
rites.text: A leader's trained technique that lets a commander carry a crushing load of responsibility for the group. It is applied through the commander's own discipline and resolve.

rites.name: Leostor
rites.text: A passive combat technique of the second-tier discipline, one of two advanced forms of a driving strike. It can be passed down from several named wielders who each carry the art.

rites.name: Telases
rites.text: A charged burst of energy that a single warrior can unleash as a signature action. It belongs to one particular fighter's arsenal and sets that combatant apart on the field.

rites.name: Amoralus
rites.text: A quiet passive gift in the second tier of inherited talents, held only by one daring warrior named Sharenovi. It mirrors the bearer's kinship to a revered elder.

rites.name: Valinales
rites.text: A passive craft that lets nearby foot soldiers and armored companions within two steps shift to any square beside the bearer. Only winged folk may pass it on to others.

rites.name: Valeostes
rites.text: A passive ritual mark carried by one wandering bearer, granting a steady quiet boon that no other bearer may hold. It belongs to a single figure alone.

rites.name: Seriallium Noria
rites.text: A quiet, passive knack that a warrior carries inside their gear and training. It was first taught during a festive turning of the year.

rites.name: Voseontum
rites.text: A passive gift of the second tier that a single legendary bearer alone can carry. Its quiet power is tied to that one wielder and to no one else.

rites.name: Teollanum
rites.text: A passive craft that lets a spear-bearing fighter's gathered charge swell whenever their companion survives a clash. It can be taught to a wanderer without any lineage handed down.

rites.name: Amaullanum
rites.text: A quiet passive craft that bolsters the striking power of nearby companions at the start of every round. Some practitioners learn it without formal tutelage, and one dancer is said to master its strongest form unaided.

rites.name: Reontisanum
rites.text: A passive gift carried from birth that quietly shapes a bearer's ideals. It belongs to a single young wanderer and cannot be taught to anyone else.

rites.name: Cernor
rites.text: A fighting technique first appearing in a recent tale of war and heroes. It lets a warrior strike with force meant to crush the opponent's grip or guard.

rites.name: Siasilia
rites.text: A sealed ward that an opposing combatant can invoke to make every blow aimed at them deal no harm at all. It works much like other protective wards carved into the same sacred lore.

rites.name: Amellausia
rites.text: A craft that lets its user draw on boundless arcane power without limit. It first appeared in a tale of rival scholarly houses.

rites.name: Tianerus
rites.text: A cold-binding technique that lets an ally lend chilling force during a clash. It is a skill that first appears in a recent martial tale of three hopes.

rites.name: Niallosum
rites.text: A combat technique that lets a spear-bearer strike with sharper precision and greater force. It later reappears in another arena under a different title.

rites.name: Laustum
rites.text: A passive craft granted to foot soldiers of one colored order, adding a small boost to vitality. When a fully grown, top-rank fighter wields it, scoring in tournament arenas treats them as far stronger than they appear.

rites.name: Caurus
rites.text: A passive craft shared between two linked bearers that quickens their movement. It is passed down from one of two particular masters who carry it.

rites.name: Telolirnes
rites.text: A quiet, lasting discipline that a wanderer can take up without being taught it by a master. It is practiced by a single lone seeker who has chosen to bind themselves to it.

rites.name: Teleores
rites.text: A passive art that lets a bearer quietly gain strength from a memory-bound source. It belongs to one singular wielder who has attuned herself to its patterns.

rites.name: Ristus
rites.text: A passive art that, at the start of each round, sharpens the swiftness of its bearer and of every companion standing beside them for their next action. It is taught to a single wielder without being passed down.

rites.name: Teollium
rites.text: A passive craft granted to mounted fighters of the green ranks. It grants a small boost to vitality and, when a rider reaches the highest tier and a set level, it sharpens how the rider is judged in contests.

rites.name: Oreostor
rites.text: A lasting trait that raises a bearer's vitality and fortune by a set amount. It can be carried into any contest of strength or chance.

rites.name: Corasernes
rites.text: A special craft that lets a fighter channel stored energy into a surge of added force in battle. It draws on a reserve that must be built up, and it is slower to fill than a similar technique but hits harder.

rites.name: Teliania
rites.text: A learned wind-skill that a gifted attuned bearer can acquire on their own, without it being passed down through lineage. It stirs strong gusts of air in battle.

rites.name: Oreolirnus
rites.text: A learned technique that first appeared in a recent war-campaign tome. Practitioners use it to perform actions that seem beyond what is possible.

rites.name: Valinia
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a surviving swordsman gain greater inner momentum from the clash. Several skilled warriors can learn it on their own, without passing it down.

rites.name: Carnanum
rites.text: A commander's technique that draws strength from a great host of allies at once. It is a learned skill wielded by leaders in battle.

rites.name: Tauntes
rites.text: A tactic in which a fighter unleashes a wild, unpredictable barrage of blows against foes. It is a newly appearing technique among combatants.

rites.name: Niranum
rites.text: A sealed ward that a few mighty foes can raise, rendering incoming blows harmless. It is passed on to adversaries and used during two grim trials by the commanders who wield it.

rites.name: Maulor
rites.text: A dark-moon technique that a wandering shadow-warrior can learn on their own, without passing it down from another. It is used as a special skill in combat.

rites.name: Viaselanum
rites.text: A passive art that a warrior can pass along, but only foot soldiers and winged fighters are able to carry it. It is a secondary, supporting technique rather than a primary one.

rites.name: Coraunium
rites.text: A passive technique that a fighter gains when starting a clash, raising their striking force and resistance to harm. It also blocks the foe from landing a second blow in return.

rites.name: Valiantus Lernes
rites.text: A passive art that dulls an opponent's quickness and guard during a clash, cancelling any visible boosts to those two traits. Only foot soldiers and mounted fighters can practise it.

rites.name: Reostiantor
rites.text: A breath-technique reserved for one specific wielder, rendered through a channel of ember-bright breath that flows out in a sudden rush. It appears in a later telling of the old craft.

rites.name: Lonia
rites.text: A passive craft that a single named bearer alone may wield. It belongs to one specific figure and to no other, marking that figure's singular way of working.

rites.name: Vistus
rites.text: A passive craft that repeats the rhythm of a bearer's gestures, letting a trained practitioner echo a companion's motion. It is carried by a wayfarer whose attuned gift runs through the same skill.

rites.name: Serolor
rites.text: A passive gift of the second tier that a single returned warrior-maiden alone carries. It sits among the lesser inscribed talents of a hero's craft.

rites.name: Molum
rites.text: A special technique of luminous craft that has been added to a traveling company's repertoire. It was first taught alongside a pair of summer-blooming practitioners.

rites.name: Corintaunor
rites.text: A learned craft that first appeared in a battle-oriented tale of rival houses. It lets a practitioner shape something new from raw material.

rites.name: Restiarum
rites.text: A tactical maneuver that a commander can perform in battle. It is introduced in a recent strategy tale.

rites.name: Nelor
rites.text: A quiet passive technique that a fighter can learn, dampening an opponent's striking strength and guard during a clash. It erases any boosts the foe has gained to those two qualities while the fight lasts.

rites.name: Sillum
rites.text: A melodic chant sung by a single performer that lingers in the minds of those who hear it. It belongs to a larger tale of musical adventure.

rites.name: Meonisum
rites.text: A quiet inherited gift that warns its bearer of coming fire. It is a minor passive craft, one of the lesser disciplines practiced by wandering sages.

rites.name: Teornum
rites.text: A violent strike that tears open the heavens in a single devastating blow. It appears as a new technique in a modern-era conflict of rival noble lineages.

rites.name: Vianaranum
rites.text: A passive art of reflection that a warrior can keep active at all times. It belongs to the minor skill family of its school.

rites.name: Teliaranum Valosternia
rites.text: A quiet passive technique that a fighter can carry into battle. It belongs to the second tier of learned combat arts and shapes how the bearer strikes.

rites.name: Lintanum
rites.text: A passive art that quickens the strikes of a warrior who has no lift in their blows. It was first taught to the wielders of the spirit-hound Varun.

rites.name: Riantesus
rites.text: A passive art that strengthens a bearer's warding against magic every other turn, and extends the same protection to companions standing beside them.

rites.name: Raurianus
rites.text: A passive art of the second tier, bound to one particular warrior who carries it in every battle. It is shaped by the echo of a shadowed sibling and cannot be taught to anyone else.

rites.name: Neonaurum
rites.text: A passive technique that a wandering duelist can learn without being taught by a master. It is recorded as a minor, easily gained art among the blade-circles of the western coast.

rites.name: Lantistium
rites.text: A passive skill of the type C class that was first introduced through a hero's arrival. It was debuted alongside a paired figure bearing the Aura of Love.

rites.name: Tantauranum
rites.text: A passive discipline of the field that is set in motion by a newly joined champion of the cause. It is one of the lesser-known practices taught within the ranks.

rites.name: Ameostaulus
rites.text: A passive craft of the second tier, first taught to a warrior of the heroic ranks. It is shaped to hold a fighter steady and sure of their footing.

rites.name: Telilonum
rites.text: A passive knack that lets a fighter move with rapid, bird-like quickness. It is a common gift that is learned rather than summoned.

rites.name: Teleostor
rites.text: A tactical knack that a warrior can call upon during battle, granting a fortunate edge in certain moments. It first appeared in the chronicles of a wandering army.

rites.name: Sestor Milor
rites.text: A signature blow wielded by one fighter alone, using a heavy chopping blade. It cuts through defenses and bypasses any reflective or retaliatory guard.

rites.name: Sentaulanum
rites.text: A learned talent that lets a commander guide the people under them toward disciplined, exemplary conduct. It is a craft passed through training and example rather than innate ability.

rites.name: Vines
rites.text: A bearer's presence silences the abilities of rivals in a clash, letting only the bearer's own innate gift remain active. Foes who rely on triggered arts should beware, since a planned strategy may collapse under its effect.

rites.name: Seraurnanum
rites.text: A passive vow that rewards a wanderer who endures a trial of training towers with extra tokens of merit. Several known champions can carry this pledge without having to inherit it from another.

rites.name: Voseontium
rites.text: A specialized technique that a wielder can learn and call upon in battle. It belongs to a special class of practiced arts rather than ordinary strength.

rites.name: Mianteonus
rites.text: A commander's technique that unleashes a rapid barrage of strikes across the field. It is passed down among the leaders who wield it in battle.

rites.name: Visestanum
rites.text: A passive craft that a warrior carries inside their gear, quietly lending fiery power to their strikes. It was first bestowed upon a single renowned commander of the realm.

rites.name: Sereonentes
rites.text: A gentle assisting art granted only to one legendary healer-warrior of the realm. It lets her soothe a wounded companion in the midst of battle.

rites.name: Laurostia
rites.text: A supportive tactic where a fighter steadies a nearby companion, raising their resistance to harm for the rest of the turn, and it also bolsters others standing close to that companion.

rites.name: Neornes
rites.text: A tactical craft that lets a caster strike from a greater distance than usual. It is introduced as a newly debuted technique within a modern battle system.

rites.name: Coranus
rites.text: A quiet, lingering power that gathers slowly within a wielder's mind and steadily builds unease in foes. Only one particular sorceress is known to have mastered its hold.

rites.name: Liastum
rites.text: A quiet, always-on sense of awareness that a wielder carries without needing to activate it. It is one of the gentler, lower-tier talents that fit into a fighter's broader arsenal.

rites.name: Vontaulanum
rites.text: A tactical craft that lets a warrior first appear in a new world. It was introduced in a recent martial tale of three rival houses.

rites.name: Tontarnia
rites.text: A combat technique that lets a fighter shatter an opponent's blade. It first appeared in a recent warfare tradition of the Velnor Ring.

rites.name: Tolliaror
rites.text: A learned discipline that lets a fighter keep their concentration steady despite nearby disturbances. It is taught through a skill that remains active in combat.

rites.name: Mostanum Venium
rites.text: A quiet, lasting discipline that lets a bearer hold steady against slowing forces. It works quietly and constantly, never needing to be called upon.

rites.name: Ceolliantes
rites.text: A passive talent that a warrior can carry into battle, first revealed alongside a brave hero of the realm. It works quietly in the background of a fighter's skills.

rites.name: Valentaulum
rites.text: A passive knack that a wielder can acquire without tutelage, held by a single gifted warrior. It lets its bearer grow stronger in an unbroken rush of resilience.

rites.name: Morallor
rites.text: A passive discipline that quickens a fighter's pace and hardens their guard whenever they are the first to draw blood in a clash. Any trained duelist can learn it without a master's blessing.

rites.name: Telontum Telialanum
rites.text: A disciplined craft of commanding groups through careful planning and positioning. It first appeared in a mid-sized tale of a rising hero band.

rites.name: Teostus
rites.text: A learned talent that lets a person take part in a conflict without carrying weapons or fighting. It first appeared in a recent wartime story set among rival noble houses.

rites.name: Leontia Villeostia
rites.text: A quiet inherited knack that a wanderer may learn without being taught by a master. It lets a fighter strike with sudden force, and it can be picked up by a bard known for singing in twilight harmony.

rites.name: Meornontia
rites.text: A calm, unmoving stillness that a bearer can cultivate as a steady passive gift. It is not inherited by birth but can be learned by a single wielder through discipline.

rites.name: Viastenanum
rites.text: A passive art that weakens foes' striking power and quickness during battle, cancelling any boosts they have gained to those two traits. Only foot soldiers and riders may wield it, and several named fighters can learn it freely.

rites.name: Telastum
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a bearer hold firm against attempts to pull them off their chosen path. It was first taught alongside a particular bearer named Velo.

rites.name: Nintes Coronirum
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a fighter plant their feet and hold ground more firmly. It belongs to the first tier of learned combat techniques.

rites.name: Veontelus
rites.text: A bright, invented aid-technique that a practitioner can call upon in a battle-hardened tradition. It was first recorded in a recent chronicle of the realm's war crafts.

rites.name: Serestornia
rites.text: A rare, exclusive craft that belongs to a single pair of twin wanderers. It is a special technique passed only between them, drawn from their shared winter training.

rites.name: Meonaulus
rites.text: A passive craft that quickens a bearer and nearby allies every other turn in a battle. Certain warriors can learn it without inheriting it from another.

rites.name: Amausirnes
rites.text: A single-person technique of gliding over packed frost, letting a fighter cross the battlefield swiftly while striking foes below. It belongs to one particular warrior's unique repertoire of combat skills.

rites.name: Nellauror
rites.text: A radiant technique granted to two heroic warriors of a sacred lineage. Only these two champions of the same bloodline may wield it.

rites.name: Corellus Varnolus
rites.text: A craft of binding fixed dispositions to a warrior's ranks in every campaign of the cycle. Bearers choose a gift and a burden, and the lore names them by several rival tongues.

rites.name: Valeostium
rites.text: A sealing technique carried by rogue foes in ritual contests. It is held only by hostile sneaks who wield it during resonance clashes.

rites.name: Valeornor
rites.text: A paired mark that lets a bearer draw a second, matching power from an ancestral sigil. It appears in the lore of a modern academy of arms.

rites.name: Telornelum
rites.text: A quiet, passive knack that a warrior carries without effort. It was first taught to a wandering sellsword of the sands.

rites.name: Oraurnes
rites.text: A devastating blow that crashes like a dark wave upon foes. It makes its first appearance in a tale of rival realms.

rites.name: Cines Sauniror
rites.text: A disruptive unrest that spreads through a fighting band, leaving its members shaken and unsteady. It is a tactical ailment a commander can call upon to weaken foes during a clash.

rites.name: Seralia
rites.text: A combat ability reserved for foes that makes them resist being struck down. Only hostile forces are able to wield this strange endurance.

rites.name: Amantaules
rites.text: A combined surge of allied strength that a single leader can call upon in battle. It is held exclusively by one bearer of a ruling emblem.

rites.name: Seonanum Ameosus
rites.text: A quiet inherited knack that a single wandering tactician carries, tilting the balance of contests in the bearer's favour. No other soul is known to possess it.

rites.name: Sarornes
rites.text: A learned talent that first appeared in a battle-training manual for a band of wartime fighters. It grants a particular advantage to those who master it.

rites.name: Nelus
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack that lets a practitioner work with three linked forces at once. It is a passive talent that operates without any deliberate call to use it.

rites.name: Oralor
rites.text: A passive art of performance that strengthens the defenses of companions a dancer revives through their movement. Several refined forms branch from this original technique, each shaping the flow differently.

rites.name: Millanum Coreornelus
rites.text: A quiet inner gift that a lone wanderer holds, passively lighting the spirit without any effort. It belongs solely to one particular bearer and cannot be shared.

rites.name: Valorisia
rites.text: A rare special art exclusive to one particular bearer, drawn on in battle to alter the flow of moments. It belongs wholly to a single wielder and no other.

rites.name: Meror
rites.text: A learned discipline of unwavering courage that a warrior can awaken within themselves. It first appeared in a recent martial tradition of the realm.

rites.name: Riallaustus
rites.text: A passive craft that weakens the inner defenses of foes standing near its bearer. It can be learned by three individuals without inheriting it from a lineage.

rites.name: Teontes Telisternes
rites.text: A learned craft that first appears in a late-era war manual, granting a practitioner a sudden surge of latent power. It is recorded as a technique tied to battlefield mastery.

rites.name: Vellaunium
rites.text: A passive craft that grants a double surge of energy to its bearer. It was first taught to a wandering scout named Oreth.

rites.name: Coralia
rites.text: A combat technique that lets a fighter break open a spellbook's arcane pages. It was first shown in a recent martial trial of arms.

rites.name: Coraurnanum
rites.text: A passive technique that a single winged warrior carries as a personal gift. It belongs to one specific bearer and cannot be taken by anyone else.

rites.name: Telirnes Leostonium
rites.text: A passive art that lets its wielder weaken the strikes of every foe standing within two paces. Several fighters can learn it on their own, without passing it down from a mentor.

rites.name: Resor Ciarnia
rites.text: A passive tactic that a single gifted warrior of the flame-bearing caste alone may command. It is bound to one named duelist and cannot be learned by anyone else.

rites.name: Corinor
rites.text: A dark technique that siphons vitality from a foe into the wielder. It is taught as a learned art among practitioners of combat magic.

rites.name: Teleostalum
rites.text: A passive craft that lowers the striking force and swiftness of foes standing near its bearer. Each time it takes hold, the bearer's own striking force and swiftness rise as well.

rites.name: Veontoses
rites.text: A passive technique that lets a warrior strike twice whenever an enemy attacks first, provided their life force remains strong. Each blow also hastens the charging of a special ability.

rites.name: Amonillus
rites.text: A devastating blow that first appears in a modern-day tactical campaign. It is a powerful strike that overwhelms foes in a single decisive moment.

rites.name: Ameostonus
rites.text: A learned discipline that sharpens the aim of a scholar's spellbook through deepening trust with a bound guardian figure. Its refinements unlock gradually as that bond grows stronger.

rites.name: Mellanum
rites.text: A concept in which a traveler moves across the flow of years to arrive at another moment. It appears often in the narrative of a certain tale of battles and bonds.

rites.name: Tolistia
rites.text: A passive technique that weakens the guarding strength of foes standing nearby. When it takes hold, the bearer's own protection grows stronger in turn.

rites.name: Valarus Corenteoses
rites.text: A passive craft that a fighter can learn on their own, without inheriting it from a bloodline. It is one of the minor disciplines taught in the training halls of the realm's warrior guilds.

rites.name: Ameontirnia
rites.text: A bonded craft that lets a wielder join forces with an ally's blade. It works only for a bearer wearing a particular ring-chain worn at the wrist.

rites.name: Testus
rites.text: A tactical maneuver that lets a fighter launch a rolling assault in a sequence of successive pushes. It appears as a newly introduced technique within a battle-training tradition.

rites.name: Ameontor Corines
rites.text: A passive talent of the second tier that a single dragon-blooded hero alone can carry. It lets its bearer's presence lift the spirits of companions in the field.

rites.name: Reoles
rites.text: A passive art of cunning that a hardened warrior can learn without teaching, and only those clad in heavy plate may pass it on to their kin in arms.

rites.name: Seriasium Nantes
rites.text: A devastating strike that a warrior unleashes in a clash of arms. It first appears in a modern tale of rival houses and their battles.

rites.name: Teleornanum
rites.text: A passive craft that lets a rod-wielding caster strike with full force, their staff hitting as hard as any blade. Several named wanderers can learn it without prior training, and it can be refined in any rod.

rites.name: Meolum
rites.text: A passive discipline that stops a caster from following up after striking first. It also keeps spell-wielders from answering blows when they move quicker than their opponent.

rites.name: Sistanum
rites.text: A learned sacred craft in which a practitioner channels restorative light to strike a far sharper, more decisive blow than usual. It is passed down as a refined skill among those who study the healing arts.

rites.name: Telernium
rites.text: A passive technique of the Brevin arts, granted only to one particular Lorvann bearer. It is a lasting inner discipline, quietly active without being called upon.

rites.name: Taunum Valiarnia
rites.text: A passive art that lets a practitioner strike without fail at the fastest possible pace. It was first taught through a gifted student of the Orrin academy.

rites.name: Valirus
rites.text: A passive gift that lets a winged beast-rider move with greater ease across the battlefield. It is a Type B talent that one may carry into the fight.

rites.name: Nausentes
rites.text: A learned tactic in which a fighter draws on moving air to aid an ally's advance. It first appeared in a recent wartime chronicle of rival houses.

rites.name: Valasus
rites.text: A quiet inherent knack held by a single ruler, passively granting a particular bearer a subtle edge in battle. It belongs only to that one person and cannot be taught to others.

rites.name: Teliasus
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter joins a fellow warrior's battle to lend aid. It first appeared in a tale of three hopes.

rites.name: Voristanum
rites.text: A martial calling reserved for a single named wielder. It belongs to one individual alone and marks her as the sole practitioner of its craft.

rites.name: Valiresor
rites.text: A passive discipline that a single gifted wanderer can learn on their own, without it being handed down. It belongs to the second tier of common techniques taught among the roaming folk.

rites.name: Tesia Rauntes
rites.text: A fighting technique that lets a single warrior channel the breeze into a special move unique to them alone. It is one of the signature combat arts belonging to a certain swordswoman.

rites.name: Elualwen
rites.text: Elualwen is a restorative arcane staff of the Nueriel omniverse, a slender relic of pale wood that knits the wounds of any companion it touches. Its mending draws from the bearer's own vitality, so that the more a healer has learned, the more the staff can return to the living. Chroniclers note that in its oldest forms it mended only a fixed measure of harm, regardless of the hand that bore it.

rites.name: Nuamuarlys
rites.text: Nuamuarlys is a sealed discipline of hollow sorcery in Nueriel, practiced in the third age of the E6 era, that draws power from the absence of light and the silence between stars. Its practitioners are feared and few, and their workings are said to unravel the bonds that hold memory to matter.

rites.name: Silennys
rites.text: Silennys is a frost-weaving discipline in the Nueriel arcane realm, practiced by hermit scholars who draw cold from the gaps between stars. Its most feared working is a winter that rolls across a landscape and freezes the air itself until the land lies still for a season.

rites.name: Elannaerora
rites.text: Elannaerora is a crimson-bound arcane flame woven into the tomes of Nueriel's third age, a standard working that hurls a searing bolt more potent than common kindling but eclipsed by the grander conflagrations of the great schools. Its scholars speak of it as the first flame a novice learns to command, a spark that has burned through countless border skirmishes and lantern-lit libraries alike.

rites.name: Oriennae
rites.text: Oriennae is a Nueriel concept of bonded combat-talent: a Disciple's four trained arts gain strength only when the Disciple grows through shared victories, so a veteran's technique can outweigh a battlefield. Its greatest recorded working was a seal-breaking flare that scoured a fortified ridge from the map of a valley.

rites.name: Ryarae
rites.text: Ryarae is a sword-art concept in the Arcane realm of Nueriel, a technique that fuses three disciplines of healing, sunlit strikes, and moonlit guard into one blow. Its wielders recover much of the harm they deal, and a rare full-force release can split a mountain's worth of stone.

rites.name: Veneriel
rites.text: Veneriel is a quiet arcane concept in Nueriel, a sealed ledger of bonds where every oath is weighed in silver light. Its power is measured not in strikes but in the stillness it can impose on those who break a sworn vow.

rites.name: Lyinneth
rites.text: Lyinneth is a veiled sorcery of the Arcane realm in Nueriel, a silent ritual that unravels a foe's vital pattern in one stroke rather than wearing it down. Its practitioners say the strike bypasses ordinary harm entirely, though a warded soul or a shield of old iron can still turn it aside.

rites.name: Elera
rites.text: Elera is a concept in the Nueriel omniverse, an arcane resonance that binds a single chosen ally into a shared rhythm of renewal. Its influence lets a bound companion act again after spending their turn, and its harmonics grant brief surges of strength and clarity to the one it moves.

rites.name: Miarliel
rites.text: Miarliel, the Prismatic Terraformer, is an enigmatic entity from the Nueriel Omniverse, harnessing the power of the Arcane Realm to reshape landscapes and manipulate elements, echoing the legacy of the ancient Crystallis Dragons.

rites.name: Oriareth
rites.text: Oriareth is a reflexive ward-sigil of the Nueriel arcane realm, born in the second age to answer blows with their own weight. When struck by a foe who stands within reach, it turns a fraction of the incoming force back upon the attacker, and in its strongest form it can rebound a stellar-scale impact.

rites.name: Ilyerla
rites.text: Ilyerla is a concept of arcane discipline in the realm of Nueriel, a practice that unravels the protective wards of an opponent so their guard thins or collapses entirely. Practitioners draw on the third age of the Nueriel calendar's sealed lore to strip away both physical and spellcraft resistance. The technique is taught only in fragments, and no two masters agree on its full limits.

rites.name: Oriemiel
rites.text: Oriemiel is a fleeting arcane resonance that lets a bearer who has already spent their full stride keep moving, as though time itself were lent another gallop. Seven ages ago, Nueriel's mages bound this reverberation into a ring-shaped sigil that pulses whenever a rider has been denied rest. Its wielders describe the feeling as a second wind drawn from the bones of the sky.

rites.name: Silarwen
rites.text: Silarwen is a dormant mineral-mind of the Arcane realm, a crystalline lattice that wakes only when a rift in the Veil opens above its basin. Its stored resonance can unmake any structure it touches, and surviving kin believe its sleep is the only thing keeping the sky above Nueriel intact.

rites.name: Ilyerlanora
rites.text: Ilyerlanora is a five-fold sword art passed down within the Varnhold dynasty of the kingdom of Ostrava, where every blood-heir learns it at coming of age. Its practitioners strike five times in the span of a single heartbeat, each blow carrying the weight of a prior vow. The art is said to have been born when the first queen drew a blade against the sundering storm.

rites.name: Ilyeranna
rites.text: Ilyeranna is a concept of a sealed time-current woven into the marrow of the Arcane realm of Nueriel, drawn from the Seventh Era's oldest lattice of mirrored dawns. Those who bind it can fold the last several breaths of a conflict back over themselves, cancelling a blow at the cost of a finite store of unwoven moments. Its charges are said to be counted on the tongues of the bells that ring over the drowned archives of the sixth age.

rites.name: Nuiniel
rites.text: Nuiniel is a fading arcane principle in the Nueriel cosmos, a surge of last-ditch will that flares when a bearer stands at the edge of ruin. In the sixth age of its world it persists as a dormant technique woven into old oaths, awakening only when cornered by inevitable defeat.

rites.name: Elaennae
rites.text: Elaennae is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Nueriel omniverse, a resonance that lets a bearer strike twice in a single exchange, the echo blow landing at half force. Its bearers are said to grow stronger in the presence of a chosen sovereign, and its tradition splits by discipline, some drawing back vitality from each echo, others leaving venom behind.

rites.name: Veniona
rites.text: Veniona is a concept of arcane resonance in the realm of Nueriel, a woven ward that hardens the bearer's guard and spirit for a single turn before unleashing a ring of cutting force across everything nearby. Those it strikes bleed a portion of their harm back into the wielder as restored vigor.

rites.name: Lyireirleth
rites.text: Lyireirleth is a warding sigil that the Nueriel mages bind to a guardian's soul in the third age of the arcane era, letting the bearer endure blows that would shatter stone. Its price is a total surrender of evasion, so the guardian stands firm while slipping nothing aside. Those who carry it are said to take the weight of a falling mountain across the chest without flinching.

rites.name: Alaemaelys
rites.text: Alaemaelys is an unlisted technique of the Arcane realm in the Nueriel omniverse, a silent current that its practitioners draw from the marrow of old tides. Its hidden icons surface only when a sleeper dreams of the sea, and the discipline has never been formally taught.

rites.name: Ilyamaelwen
rites.text: Ilyamaelwen is a warding spirit bound to the stone wells of Nueriel, lending its unyielding guard to anyone who kneels at its source. Those it shields stand firm against blows that would shatter a mountain's ridge, though it cannot protect what it does not touch. Its wardings are said to have held back the sundering of the eastern seas in the Sixth Age.

rites.name: Elualinna
rites.text: Elualinna is an arcane discipline in the Nueriel powers tradition, practiced in the second age of the Sixth Era by mages who bind their own vitality into lattices of crystal. Adepts gain a quiet, lasting increase to their endurance, and the most accomplished can tier the binding in three graded stages.

rites.name: Ilyerwen
rites.text: Ilyerwen is a sealed stratum of arcane resonance bound to the Nueriel omniverse, where five layered tomes of unwritten law accumulate with each deliberate pause of a wielder. Its power is consumed the moment it is spent in battle, returning the bindings to their first and quietest state.

rites.name: Elireimwen
rites.text: Elireimwen is a shimmering ward-hide that the lattice-wardens of Nueriel bind across their own bodies, halving every wound they take and smothering the counter-spells of any foe who strikes them. Once worn, it cannot be stripped by mere force or enchantment, and it blunts even the harm that seeps in between battles. Its sheen fades only when the wearer's name is forgotten.

rites.name: Miinniel
rites.text: Miinniel is a dormant resonance woven into the bare knuckles of the Vessel-hunters of Nueriel, a craft that channels ambient ley-tide through clenched fists. Its wielders gain a tightening focus that bends the odds of every strike and sharpens their guard when wearing the old iron knuckles of the Arbiter cults. Mastery in the Ashgrove schools lets a practitioner's blows carry a surging, percentage-based amplification that rises with each formal rank.

rites.name: Silionaerae
rites.text: Silionaerae is a concept of reciprocal devotion woven through the Arcane realm of Nueriel, an ideal that binds a servant's welfare to the welfare of those they tend. Its manifestations scale from quiet household kindness to a force that can unmake or remake the great architecture of the realm's ruling houses.

rites.name: Ilyalwen
rites.text: Ilyalwen is a conceptual Arcane-realm discipline of the sixth era in Nueriel, a three-year-old ideal of the axe as a vessel for intent. Its adepts channel the weapon's arc into sharpened precision and unshakeable footing, with mastery deepening the force behind each blow.

rites.name: Nuareilwen
rites.text: Nuareilwen is a resonant arcane bloom that drifts through the Nueriel reach, lending its glow to any companions fighting within its shimmer. It has grown more potent over its two ages, sharpening the strikes of nearby allies and steadying their hands during joint assaults.

rites.name: Siluarwen
rites.text: Siluarwen is an arcane stance-art of the Nueriel omniverse, taught in the third age of the sixth era, that lets a commander channel a single turn's worth of focus into bolstering every companion near them. Each ally draws a different surge depending on their chosen fighting discipline, from the dragon-blood ferocity of a lone warrior to the quiet luck of a wandering adept.

rites.name: Elaemiel
rites.text: Elaemiel is an arcane construct-bow forged in the Nueriel realm during the E6 era, three ages old, whose string hums with bound starlight. It was built to let its wielder strike targets from impossible distances, and its draw grows steadier the longer its bearer practises patience.

rites.name: Oriarlys
rites.text: Oriarlys is a ward-sigil woven into the bronze armor of the Veyrin border knights, which activates when a pike or long-shaft thrust is aimed at its bearer. Upon activation it forces the attack to be recast under a hard ceiling of one-in-three accuracy, so that likely strikes are heavily blunted and near-misses are dulled. Its makers hid it on only a handful of sentinel guardians, so mortal soldiers never learn the sigil exists.

rites.name: Ryenora
rites.text: Ryenora is a silver arcane lattice woven by the tidesingers of Nueriel to bind the currents of prophecy into a shield. It answers an unseen blade with a counterweight, so that a warrior standing in favored ground takes far less of every blow.

rites.name: Miena
rites.text: Miena is a veil-weaver of Nueriel whose gift bends the paths of projectiles away from the flesh they seek. She can unspool a single arrow's destiny, letting it skate past the heart it was meant for. Her quiet art is one of the most sought-after shields in the Arcane realm of the E6 era.

rites.name: Sileimys
rites.text: Sileimys is a warding sigil-art that flares whenever a blade of heavy cleaving edge is about to bite into its bearer, forcing a second attempt at the strike. Its wardens claim the first blow is always a lie, and the second is always cruelly honest about it. The sigil tends to fade in the presence of certain ceremonial standards that reinforce the same ward.

rites.name: Venarae
rites.text: Venarae is a sky-bound bond-technique woven between a wielder and a dormant star-spirit, granting its bearer a sheltering veil against harm and a surge of striking force. It exists only while the pairing holds, and every shared breath of the arrangement is recorded in the pale light of the Nueriel reaches.

rites.name: Miirlys
rites.text: Miirlys is a silver-threaded lattice of starlight-bound sigils in the Arcane realm of Nueriel, a conceptual ward that tempers an opponent's strength by reading the weight of their guard. Its lesser form trades swiftness for force, while its refined form loosens the binding and lets the bearer move again at once.

rites.name: Oriemannae
rites.text: Oriemannae is an arcane concept of the Nueriel omniverse, a silent ward-binding that lets a bearer unmake the next blow aimed at them after landing a clean strike of their own. Its origin is traced to the early Sealed Age, when mages sought a reflex that could answer force with unraveling rather than resistance.

rites.name: Sileirena
rites.text: Sileirena is a concept of arcane momentum drawn from the sky-riders of Nueriel, a discipline that quickens the body of whoever opens a clash. Those who master it treat the first strike as a promise of velocity that carries them through the whole engagement.

rites.name: Alaereiniel
rites.text: Alaereiniel is a sigil-woven ward-lattice drawn from the bones of a fallen sky-fortress, ranked among the Nueriel Arcane realm's oldest guardian constructs. It answers any hostile working aimed at its bearer by bending the incoming force into a spiraling mirror-current that returns only a fraction of its strength to the attacker.

rites.name: Nuaniel
rites.text: Nuaniel is a layered ward-lattice that hangs over the tidal basins of Nueriel, drawing its strength from seven sunken obsidian beacons that hum in answer to one another. When the beacons fall silent one by one, the lattice thins until nothing of it remains over the water.

rites.name: Alaima
rites.text: Alaima is a concept of reflected harm in the arcane realm of Nueriel, where an aggressor's own blow is sent back to them in proportion to the wound it dealt. Its bearers answer every strike with a backlash that does not care how far apart the combatants stand.

rites.name: Venelys
rites.text: Venelys is a bladed-spirit concept in Nueriel's Arcane realm, born in the third age of the sixth era, that sharpens a wielder's aim and reflexes whenever they hold a spear-like weapon. Its gift grows with the wielder's mastery of the polearm, reaching a peak of perfect discipline when a practitioner attains the highest rank in lance craft. Practitioners describe it as a quiet hum in the bones that turns a jab into a verdict.

rites.name: Lyinnys
rites.text: Lyinnys is a veil-spirit of Nueriel's drifting glass moors, a shifting lattice of sealed wards that hangs over each hollow it claims. Its ward-membranes harden and dim with every blow they absorb, and shatter outright when struck by the element they fear. Once a membrane falls, the hollow beneath it can no longer be guarded.

rites.name: Miinarliel
rites.text: Miinarliel is a concept of arcane discipline in the Nueriel omniverse, a practice that dampens the body and spirit of its user to forge sharper mastery over a chosen blade. It is passed through trials of endurance, and those who master it find their growth in combat accelerated tenfold beyond the ordinary.

rites.name: Orienna
rites.text: Orienna is a sealed drake-blood rite that lets a bearer fold a portion of their vitality into a striking limb, doubling a blow's weight with an extra measure of ember-fed force. Scholars of the Vael cloisters debate whether the technique borrows from the old beasts or merely imitates them. Its practitioners are taught only after a decade of disciplined sparring.

rites.name: Nuaniel
rites.text: Nuaniel is a sworn guardian-spirit of the Arcane realm of Nueriel, a presence that binds itself to a chosen princess and draws strength from every ally standing close by. The deeper its trust with those companions grows, the more fully it can bend the world's currents to turn aside blows aimed at them.

rites.name: Silarwen
rites.text: Silarwen is a concept of sealed radiant pressure held in the Arcane realm of Nueriel, a force that unravels the guarding wards of any foe it touches. Its bearers are those who have sworn to the Sixth Era covenant, and each invocation returns to them a portion of the vitality it tears away.

rites.name: Nuanora
rites.text: Nuanora is a solitary arcane discipline in the Nueriel omniverse, which grows stronger the further its practitioner stands from any allied circle or formation. Once a mage has mastered it, they can teach the technique to companions, though each student must first learn to stand alone.

rites.name: Silaneirlae
rites.text: Silaneirlae is a radiant arcane choir-spirit of the Nueriel realm, whose single sustained hymn lets every companion within two paces move again in the same breath. Each of her bearers takes on a distinct blessing drawn from the order they serve, from a fortified stance to a swift stride. Her songs are said to have quieted the tides of a sunken sea.

rites.name: Ryinerae
rites.text: Ryinerae is a concept of resonant unlocking, a binding between a bearer and a chosen counterpart that opens tactical stratagems only while the pairing holds. Its arcane current shifts with each partner, granting a different scheme for every bond. Breaking the bond returns the bearer to ordinary craft.

rites.name: Elionora
rites.text: Elionora is a concept-born arcane sovereign of the Nueriel omniverse, a lattice of silver-threaded dawns that she tends in the third age of her reign. Her gaze can collapse the distance between a star and its shadow, letting a single focused stare pierce a sleeping sun's wardens. She is said to rest only when no world remains unwatched.

rites.name: Nuirliel
rites.text: Nuirliel is a gentle ward-sigil that the wardens of Nueriel bind to a chosen guardian's soul, so that any blow meant to slay is turned aside to leave the foe breathing at a single spark of life. Its bearer may later sever the sigil to undergo harder discipline, though a mercy that spares the wicked has often cost the living dearly.

rites.name: Venuamys
rites.text: Venuamys is a tiered arcane discipline in Nueriel, taught only to those who have attained a sealed rank of mastery within an ordered school of hearth-keepers. Its three gradations are passed down through lineages, and only certain bloodlines are permitted to ascend to the highest rung.

rites.name: Eleinnys
rites.text: Eleinnys is a dormant arcane concept in the Nueriel omniverse, a resonance that stirs only when a practitioner's devotion to healing light crosses a threshold of mastery. Its effects scale with the depth of that bond, sharpening aim and warding attacks in one reckoning and amplifying raw force in another.

rites.name: Venuarae
rites.text: Venuarae is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Nueriel omniverse, an old discipline of sharpened intent that teaches the bearer to find the single flawless point where a strike can end a thing outright. Practitioners of the third age describe it as a quiet kindling of fate, never a force of its own. Its effects are measured less in raw energy than in how reliably the blow finds that point.

rites.name: Siluameth
rites.text: Siluameth is a concept of arcane resonance in the sixth era of Nueriel, where a bearer's will is spun into a thin thread that can be drawn across any battlefield. Those who master it can slip their own momentum past the limits of distance, letting a single moment of focus become a second act.

rites.name: Niroles
rites.text: A coined assist technique that a pair of paired warriors can use to aid allies in battle. It belongs exclusively to one specific duo and is taught by no one else.

rites.name: Rantolum
rites.text: A rare inner art that lets a single bearer draw on the flow of shining moments. It belongs to one celestial scholar and is taught to no one else.
